jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Leads
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we're revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end\-to\-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.


The CIH Inventory \& Leads Program serves as the primary engine for capturing and converting high\-intent consumer traffic into real estate transactions. Through strategic partnerships with Redfin.com and Rocket Mortgage, the program delivers a diversified lead pipeline to agents, including high\-volume web inquiries and "finance\-first" pre\-qualified buyers.



As a **Program Coordinator, Leads**, you are responsible for serving as the operational backbone of the CIH Inventory \& Leads Program by owning the intake, resolution, and continuous improvement of all field\-facing inquiries. You will work closely with Corporate Strategy and cross\-functional partners to ensure issues are resolved quickly and accurately while identifying root causes and strengthening the systems that support execution. This is an operations\-focused role at the intersection of support, process improvement, and field experience, ensuring inbound inquiries are handled efficiently while transforming recurring issues into structured insights that enhance product, streamline processes, and reduce future demand.


**Core Responsibilities**



* Inbound Queue Ownership


* Own the centralized intake of all agent and field inquiries related to CIH inventory and leads, across inboxes, slack channels, feedback loops and escalations
* Triage, prioritize, and resolve issues with urgency and sound judgment
* Maintain and enforce response SLAs (same\-day where possible)
* Create structure in what is currently a fragmented inbound environment

* Resolution Excellence \& Field Communication


* Deliver clear, actionable, and consistent responses to agents and field leaders to enable, surprise and delight
* Ensure appropriate visibility to RVPs, Sales Managers, and Agent Experience partners
* Standardize response frameworks to eliminate variability and confusion
* Act as a trusted point of contact for field\-facing issue resolution

* Pattern Recognition \& Issue Escalation


* Identify recurring issues, friction points, and systemic gaps
* Categorize inbound volume into actionable themes
* Translate field pain into structured insights for Product, PMO, and leadership
* Data for support and QA resourcing; insights for EC; evidence for prioritization by product
* Escalate with clarity. It is imperative to separate noise from true signal

* Knowledge Systems \& Enablement


* Build and maintain a centralized knowledge base and SSOT, including:
* + FAQs
	+ Response templates for cross\-functional teams
	+ Escalation playbooks to product, support
* Continuously refine documentation based on real\-world usage
* Partner with Field Enablement to proactively reduce inbound questions
* Drive the shift from reactive support self\-service \+ proactive education

* Cross\-Functional Coordination


* Serve as the daily connection between Field, Product, PMO, and Marketplace teams
* Ensure issues are not only resolved, but addressed at the root level
* Track and follow through on escalations to closure
* Hold a high bar for operational accountability across teams


**Success Metrics**


* SLA adherence (response time)
* Time to resolution
* Reduction in repeat / duplicate inquiries
* % of issues resolved at root cause (vs. one\-off fixes)
* Field sentiment and confidence in the program
* Adoption and utilization of knowledge base resources


**Ideal Profile**


* Highly structured operator who thrives in ambiguity and brings order to complex systems
* Exceptional written and verbal communicator—clear, concise, and action\-oriented
* Strong pattern recognition and problem\-solving skills
* Comfortable managing high\-volume workflows without sacrificing quality
* Experience in real estate, marketplace operations, or support functions preferred
* Bias toward ownership


**Work Location \& Schedule:** This is a full\-time, agent and brokerage\-facing position (40 hours per week) and ideally in a Compass International Holdings Hub location.


**Compensation:** The expected base pay for this position is $25 \- $30 per per hour. This range reflects our good\-faith estimate of what we intend to offer for this role at the time of posting. Final offers within this range will depend on job\-related factors such as experience, skills, and internal equity. Additional compensation elements, such as bonuses, commissions, or equity grants, may be available, along with a full benefits program. We remain committed to fair pay practices and compliance with all California transparency requirements.


**Perks that You Need to Know About:**



Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele\-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

  


**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**
At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

jobs.title: Purchasing and Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We're looking for a detail\-oriented, communicative, and self\-motivated individual to join our office team. This role sits at the intersection of purchasing, vendor coordination, customer communication, and production support. You'll be a key link between our shop floor, our suppliers, our outside processing vendors, and our customers — keeping jobs moving and people informed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Purchasing \& Procurement**

* Source and purchase raw materials (bar stock, plate, extrusions, etc.) based on job requirements and production schedules
* Solicit and compare quotes (RFQs) from material suppliers and select vendors based on price, lead time, and quality
* Issue and manage vendor purchase orders accurately and on time
* Receive purchase orders into the ERP system (JobBOSS), verify quantities and documentation, and flag discrepancies

**Outside Processing Coordination**

* Submit work orders to outside processing vendors (plating, heat treat, anodize, grinding, etc.)
* Actively follow up with vendors to ensure on\-time return of parts relative to job due dates
* Maintain visibility into all open outside processing jobs and escalate delays proactively
* Track and manage outside processing aging to prevent jobs from slipping

**Customer Communication**

* Provide proactive order status updates to customers via phone and email
* Respond to delivery inquiries and communicate any schedule changes clearly and professionally
* Coordinate with internal team members to gather accurate delivery information before communicating externally

**Production \& Team Support**

* Work closely with the shop floor, scheduling, and management to understand priorities and help meet production deadlines
* Assist with data entry, job tracking, and record\-keeping in ERP and project management systems
* Support the quoting team by gathering material and outside processing costs for open RFQs
* Help maintain organized files for POs, certifications, material certs, and vendor records
* Assist with accounts payable tasks such as matching vendor invoices to POs and coding for approval
* Handle incoming calls and route or respond as appropriate
* Pitch in on general office tasks as needed — this is a small team and we all wear multiple hats

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 2\+ years of experience in a purchasing, operations, or customer service role — ideally in manufacturing, machining, or a related industry
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple open tasks simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication
* Comfortable working in an ERP system for PO creation, receiving, and job tracking
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* Self\-starter who doesn't need to be micromanaged — you take ownership of your work

**Preferred**

* Experience in a machine shop, job shop, or precision manufacturing environment
* Familiarity with outside processing operations (plating, anodize, heat treat, etc.)
* Experience with JobBOSS or similar job shop ERP
* Experience with Monday.com or similar operations/project management tools
* Understanding of basic manufacturing documents: travelers, certifications, inspection reports

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Pay Rate: $26\.00 – $30\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Monday – Friday

Pay: $26\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

jobs.description:
**Office \& Production Coordinator \| North Hollywood, CA \| Full\-Time, On\-Site**

About us

Dreamliner Construction is a licensed home remodeling company (CSLB \#1130285\) serving Los Angeles and the Inland Empire. We build kitchens, bathrooms and room additions, and more. We are growing fast and need someone to run the paperwork side of every job so our crews and sales team can keep moving.

The role

You are the engine behind every project. From the moment a job is sold until the final invoice is paid, you keep the file complete, the permits moving and the homeowner informed. This is a production\-focused office role with lots of phone and computer time.

What you will do

* Build and manage project files: contracts, change orders, invoices, permits and photos
* Prepare contracts and send them out for electronic signature, then track them until signed
* Submit and follow up on city permit applications and inspections
* Create and send invoices and record payments in QuickBooks
* Keep trackers and documents up to date in Google Sheets and Google Docs
* Call and email homeowners with project updates, scheduling and next steps
* Reach out to potential clients and follow up on leads
* Order office supplies and marketing materials (flyers, door hangers, yard signs, business cards)
* Support the owners, sales team and field crews with whatever keeps jobs on track

What you bring

* 2\+ years of office or administrative experience (construction or remodeling is a big plus)
* Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Docs and QuickBooks
* Clear, friendly communication on the phone, by email and in person
* Organized with details: you notice when a signature, date or document is missing
* Comfortable switching between phone calls and computer work all day
* Good energy, open to learning and hungry to grow
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus

What we offer

* $26/hour, full\-time (about $4,500/month)
* Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM
* Paid holidays and paid sick leave
* Performance bonus
* A clear path to Production Manager as the company grows
* Direct training from the owners

How to apply (required)

We do not hire from resumes alone. To be considered, record a short video (3 minutes max) answering the five questions below, and send the link to info@mydreamliner.com with the subject line "Office Coordinator: Your Full Name". Loom, unlisted YouTube or a Google Drive link all work. Please make sure the link is viewable.

Start your video by saying the word "Blueprint."

* Tell us about yourself and why this role at a remodeling company caught your eye.
* Describe a time you managed a lot of files, deadlines or moving pieces at once. How did you stay organized?
* Tell us about a time you handled a frustrated customer on the phone. What did you say, and how did it end?
* What is something you taught yourself recently, and how did you learn it?
* Tell us about a mistake you made at work and what you did about it.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.

Pay: $25\.78 \- $29\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

Job Introduction:

At Sprouts Farmers Market, the Administrative Coordinator is responsible for in\-store accounting procedures, cash and funds, timekeeping, and payroll transmissions. The Administrative Coordinator keeps store files up to date and maintains an efficient stock of office supplies. They also partner with Human Resources and Store Management on hiring, onboarding, team building, and conflict resolution.
Overview of Responsibilities:
* Consistently demonstrate a positive attitude, organizational skills, high level of accuracy, attention to detail, time management skills, and willingness to learn new products.
* Take direction, communicate, and collaborate effectively with others.
* Collect, verify, and distribute tills and change drawers.
* Total all checks, cash, credit cards, and create reports from the previous day.
* Oversee the balancing of the safe and create refund reports.
* Prepare bank deposits and record all data for cash, checks, food stamps, WIC instruments, and charge vendor coupons.
* Help maintain front end security to control cash, shrink, and dishonesty.
* Facilitate hiring, onboarding, and training of new employees.
* Process internal transfers and job/pay changes.
* Support a positive and engaging work environment while adhering to all safety, health, and compliance regulations.
* Help plan and execute team building and recognition events.
* Pull and distribute sales reports for each department.
* Stay up to date on company procedures, policies, and benefits to keep store employees informed.
* Keep store files organized and up to date.
* Order office supplies to maintain an efficient stock level.
* Ensure timekeeping and payroll functions are completed correctly and on time.
* Maintain a clean, sanitized, and organized office and work areas.
* Demonstrate product knowledge and provide prompt, friendly service to help customers make their selections.
* Remain informed of sales and ad items to assist customers in a prompt and friendly manner.
* Adhere to all safety, health, and compliance regulations.
* Flexible to perform other related duties as assigned.
* To maximize labor productivity and customer service, the Core Managers assign secondary roles for
Administrative Coordinators to perform after completing the daily AC tasks. Supporting the Front End as a Cashier to cover breaks and business rushes is one of the secondary roles of the AC and Back\-up AC. To provide the most accountable environment, **ACs trained as a Head Cashier may hold red\-cards and perform Head Cashier duties.**


Qualifications:
* Must be at least 18 years of age.
* Must have a High school diploma or equivalent.
* 1\-2 years of experience in retail store accounting, administrative, and human resources procedures preferred.
* Regular, dependable attendance is an essential function of this position. Shift schedules include 8\-10 hours with scheduled breaks.
* Availability to work a flexible schedule, including some nights, weekends, and holidays preferred.
* Be proficient in Outlook, Excel, and Word with knowledge of bookkeeping/accounting and human resources software.
* Lift 30 pounds and push/pull less than 5 pounds.

* Sit for extended periods and perform repetitive hand, wrist, finger, and eye movement.
* Wear PPE consistent with the task assignment, including but not limited to non\-slip, closed\-toe shoes, long pants, hair/beard covers, a face\-covering or mask, and gloves (latex and or cut\-resistant).

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

Client Account Managers are the primary contacts for AECOM’s relationships with mining clients that are strategically important at a regional, business line, or global level. They are responsible for developing, growing, and sustaining our mining business with their client(s), working across our organization to deliver integrated solutions that leverage our full suite of mining capabilities, technical expertise, and local and global resources. * + FAQs

Drive the shift from reactive support* self\-service \+ proactive education

Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. jobs.title: Account Manager, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
**Trial Library is an AI\-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine.**

**About Trial Library**

Trial Library is an AI\-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option \- improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840\+ clinics and 3,000\+ providers nationwide.

  


**About the Role**
------------------



Trial Library is looking for an Account Manager, Life Sciences to own and grow a book of assigned accounts. You will be responsible for nurturing these relationships, identifying new opportunities within them, and running those opportunities through discovery, proposal, and contract execution. You'll work closely with the commercial team and customer success to keep accounts healthy and expanding over time. Occasional lead generation may be required to support pipeline, but this is not the core focus of the role.



This role is ideal for someone who understands the clinical trial landscape, clinical operations from the inside, whether through CRO, sponsor, or site\-side operational experience, and who also has the relationship\-building and sales instincts to turn that industry knowledge into deeper client partnerships and new opportunities within existing accounts.



### **Your Responsibilities**


* Account Ownership \& Nurturing: Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned book of accounts, building trust and staying close to evolving study needs to identify where Trial Library can add value.
* Opportunity Generation: Proactively surface new opportunities within assigned accounts, such as additional studies, expanded scope, new therapeutic areas, through regular check\-ins and relationship\-building.
* Discovery \& Qualification: Run discovery calls to understand an account’s's trial needs, patient recruitment challenges, and decision\-making process; qualify opportunities and prioritize pipeline accordingly.
* Proposal Development: Build and present tailored proposals and pricing that speak directly to an account’s study design, therapeutic area, and recruitment/retention goals.
* Deal Nurturing \& Negotiation: Manage relationships through the full sales cycle, keeping momentum through follow\-ups, objection handling, and internal coordination, all the way to contract execution.
* Contracting: Partner with legal and leadership to finalize contract terms and ensure a clean, accurate handoff into onboarding.
* CRM \& Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records of account activity, opportunities, and pipeline in the CRM to support forecasting and reporting.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Commercial teams and Customer Success to ensure assigned accounts sustain long\-term retention and growth.
* Occasional Lead Generation: From time to time, support broader pipeline efforts by prospecting new clients, sponsors, or CROs through outbound outreach, networking, or referrals
### **Your Requirements**


* Clinical trial operational experience: hands\-on background in clinical trial operations (e.g., CRA, site coordinator, CRO project support, sponsor\-side trial management, or similar), giving you credibility and fluency when speaking with sponsors and sites.
* Experience supporting patient recruitment, retention, or site support services.
* **Direct sales pitching experience: comfortable sitting face\-to\-face with clients to pitch services, present proposals, and close deals.**
* Account management experience: a track record of managing and growing client relationships, identifying expansion opportunities, and closing deals in a clinical research context.
* Strong ability to build rapport and trust with sponsors and clients, translating technical/operational knowledge into a compelling client conversation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable running discovery calls, delivering proposals, and negotiating terms.
* Highly organized, self\-motivated, and comfortable owning an account book and its pipeline independently.
* Experience with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and a commitment to clean, consistent data hygiene.
### **Nice to Have**


* Existing network or relationships within sponsor, CRO, or site organizations.
* Familiarity with specific therapeutic areas relevant to Trial Library's current client base.
**Compensation \& On\-Site Requirement**
----------------------------------------



This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, with a requirement of three days per week in the office; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. The salary range for this position is **$108,000–$135,000** per year and reflects a good faith estimate of base pay for candidates working in this location. In addition to base pay, this role includes a target annual bonus of 10% of base salary, bringing on\-target earnings to approximately **$118,800–$148,500** per year. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.


### **Why Trial Library**


* Meaningful impact — helping patients access clinical trials faster through better technology and workflows
* High ownership environment — autonomy to build, test, and influence strategy across the business
* Collaborative team culture — low ego, high trust, and close partnership across functions
* Opportunity for growth — join at an early stage with meaningful exposure to company\-building and decision\-making
### **Our Core Values**


* Ally is our favorite moniker
* The broadest reach is worth the effort
* Celebrate measurable improvements in access and outcomes
* Fearless advocates for representation in research
* Incentives matter to s

**JOB SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Aquatics Director, the Aquatics Operations Coordinator assists with planning and coordinating pool operations, including **training and supervising lifeguards** , developing and executing staffing schedules, overseeing the facility and equipment operations, implementing policies and procedures, and ensuring the pool is in compliance and operating under best demonstrated practices. This


position will maintain a safe environment that upholds the Trefethen Aquatic Center’s written standards, while ensuring that the facility remains a major part of a vibrant campus, including its facilities, programming, and the safety of all users.


**Weekend, early morning, evening, and holiday work hours will be required.**

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree required with 3\-5 years of related experience and/or training or equivalent
* combination of education and experience.
* Knowledge of best practices in Aquatic Facility management and programming.
* Current Red Cross Lifeguard certification.
* Current Red Cross Lifeguard Instructor certification (or ability to obtain within 60 days).
* Current First Aid for Public Safety Personnel certification (Title 22\).
* Certified Pool Operator/Aquatic Facility Operator (preferred).
* Ability to navigate the American Red Cross SABA platform.
* **Demonstrated strength in ability to communicate, negotiate, and problem\-solving skills necessary to successfully manage issues when resolving conflicts related to direct reports/members/others.**
* Must be able to perform duties of a physical nature, including standing, lifting, sitting, walking, and swimming.

--------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Assist with scheduling the staff using When to Work software, and substitute when needed.

* **Ability to identify** **problems, assess alternatives, render consistent and logical decisions.**
* Provide general customer service **and cashiering;** assist with signage, schedules and updating the website.
* Assist with set\-up, management, and coordination of special events (swim team practices and meets, water polo practices and games/tournaments, campus events, etc.).
* Help plan, organize, schedule, and coordinate summer swim lesson programs.
* Teach American Red Cross courses and provide certificates.
* Work with staff to ensure student program support.
* Manage conflicts and effectively negotiate resolutions.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth\-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It's hard to believe that it's 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We're here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

### **About the role**



As a Mid Market Account Manager, you will be a member of our client\-facing team \- responsible for the commercial relationship with our customers (Property Management Companies) within our Mid Market segment. You'll own and operate a book of business where consistency, prioritization, and process discipline matter as much as relationship depth. This is a partner role \- you will act as the customer's advisor and point of contact \- to maintain, retain, and grow the business relationship at scale.


### **What you'll do**


**Portfolio Management \& Prioritization**


* Own and operate a high\-volume book of business, prioritizing your time based on account health, engagement signals, and revenue opportunity rather than applying a uniform cadence to every account
* Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene \- accurate account data, activity logging, and pipeline/renewal tracking across the full portfolio
* Identify at\-risk accounts early using usage and engagement data, and escalate or intervene before renewal risk becomes churn


**Relationship Management \& Engagement**


* Establish and maintain relationships with day\-to\-day and senior stakeholders across your portfolio
* Run structured, efficient touchpoints (e.g., QBRs, check\-ins) calibrated to account tier rather than a one\-size\-fits\-all high\-touch model
* Act as the primary point of contact for your accounts, looping in specialists or leadership for higher\-complexity escalations
* Attend industry events and conduct on\-site visits selectively, prioritizing your highest\-opportunity or highest\-risk accounts \- at this volume, travel is the exception rather than the default


**Commercial Execution**


* Execute commercial negotiations efficiently and accurately across a large account count
* Identify and act on upsell/cross\-sell opportunities surfaced through data and playbooks, applying repeatable plays rather than building bespoke account strategy for every account
* Contribute to and help refine the playbooks, segmentation logic, and tooling that the Mid Market motion runs on as the segment matures at Flex

### **Key qualifications**


* Account Management Experience: 2\-4\+ years in Account Management or Customer Success, ideally managing a book of business at volume (multiple concurrent accounts, not a small handful)
* Experience owning renewals and standard commercial negotiations; comfortable operating within defined playbooks and pricing parameters rather than bespoke deal structuring
* Process Orientation: Strong organizational and prioritization skills \- proven ability to triage a large portfolio and direct time to where it has the most impact
* Data\-Driven: Comfortable using account health, usage, and engagement signals to identify risk and opportunity, and to decide where limited time is best spent
* Strong Communication Skills: High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly and efficiently across a high volume of relationships
* Tech Proficiency: Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM is a plus; experience with customer success or health\-scoring tooling is a plus
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams
* Self Starter: Comfortable operating in a segment where process, tooling, and playbooks are still maturing, and willing to help build them
* Quick Learner: Ability to adapt, learn, and iterate swiftly within the rapid changes in the PropTech/FinTech landscape. Comfortable with ambiguity and a test\-and\-learn mindset
* T.O.E: Last, but certainly not least, Team Over Everything. Our positive, team first culture is everything here at Flex. This role requires an even temperament that is always willing to put the team ahead of individual recognition.

### **Life at Flex**



We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.


**Offices**



Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on\-site expectations of 2\-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.


**Benefits**



For full\-time U.S. employees we offer:


* Competitive medical, dental, and vision
* Company equity
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Unlimited paid time off \+ 13 company paid holidays
* Parental leave
* Free Flex subscription


 For full\-time non\-U.S. employees, we offer:


* Competitive compensation \+ company equity
* Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Account Manager, Emerging Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.



We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.



To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.



Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture.



If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.


As part of the Braze Enterprise Sales Team, you will partner with Emerging Enterprise Account Executives across Braze's client portfolio to ensure they maximize value from our technology and services and grow the relationship. This is a quota\-carrying role, with the opportunity to work with some of the largest brands on the planet.


### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Commercially expand customer relationships in collaboration with the Account Executive. You will work in partnership, but have primary responsibility to develop and close those opportunities up to $75K
* Proactively analyze customer product usage and identify "white space" within accounts and new business units for cross\-sell and upsell opportunities

* Coordinate resources to drive feature exploration and adoption
* Achieve quarterly upsell and renewals targets
* Occasionally travel for onsite customer engagement, meeting with and selling to existing customers.

### **WHO YOU ARE**


* 2\+ years of experience in Sales or Account Management, SaaS sales, with at least half of that time spent:
* + in a quota\-carrying role
	+ working with companies with 2,000\+ employees
* Drive, determination, and accountability
* Excellent product knowledge and ability to learn a feature\-rich application
* Outstanding verbal, written, and stand\-up presentation skills, with experience presenting value propositions to executive teams
* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Google Office, MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Keynote
* Prior experience with Salesforce.com CRM, or other CRM used to manage sales pipeline
* Excellent organizational skills and time management abilities
* Proven ability to quickly get up to speed on new cloud apps and tools
* A proven networker in your daily life
* Up\-to\-date on digital trends, especially in the mobile, web, and email space
* Background in Enterprise SaaS sales for Mobile and/or Marketing Technology is a plus
* Prior experience in a startup technology company is a plus


For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $85,000 and $100,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $170,000 and $200,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.



\#LI\-Hybrid


**WHAT WE OFFER**


*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*



From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work\-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:


* Competitive compensation that may include equity
* Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
* Flexible paid time off
* Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
* Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
* Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
* A curated in\-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
* Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company\-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
* Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
* Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®


**ABOUT BRAZE**  

  

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging.™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross\-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al\-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.  

  

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager-Print Sales
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Regional Account Manager, Commercial (RAM) is a strategic, consultative sales professional responsible for prospecting, cultivating and penetrating sales within selected (named) corporate/regional accounts. The RAM also prospects for large, strategic corporate customers that can be added into the portfolio. Following the FXO sales process, this position will identify, acquire, activate and grow FedEx Office customers. The RAM serves as the primary contact for developing long\-term customer relationships and negotiating, securing, and activating program purchase commitments at established price levels. The RAM uses business acumen to identify unique solutions from the FedEx Office (FXO) suite of products and services that match the customers’ business objectives. The portfolio's assigned customers are primarily located in North California. **Applicants should reside in Nor Cal. This is a work from home position.**

 **GENERAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

*(This is a representative list of the general duties the position may be asked to perform, and is not intended to be all\-inclusive)*

* Serves as a trusted advisor to the customer using a proactive, strategic approach, while developing tactical plans to drive the strategy and revenue delivery
* Achieves all sales activity standards, and revenue and performance objectives related to retention and growth of both existing and new customer prospects
* Upon identifying customer business objectives, identifies and demonstrates how FXO products and services meet customer needs
* Develop strategies to grow, enhance and maintain long\-term profitable customer relationships
* Actively partner with both Sales and Operations leadership
* Engage resources required, both corporate and field, to support sales implementation and activation efforts
* Function as liaison between customer and FXO corporate teams, plus vendor partners as needed
* Manage the entirety of assigned customers and travel when necessary to locations (with possible national travel) within the account, as required to include scheduling and conducting regular in\-person visits to new and existing customers
* Provide pricing information and pricing levels to named account base, per established pricing guidelines
* Interact with Sales leadership and support resources to develop and execute sales strategies for existing customers and new business development
* Participate in the identification and qualification of new customer prospects, and provide relevant information to be considered for the customer base
* Initiate marketing activities to activate FXO services to defined customer segments
* Ensure that customers are trained to utilize the FXO ordering and purchasing guidelines for products
* Drive target products and promotions, as directed
* Work with other sales resources in a team selling capacity to include involvement with other FedEx operating companies and secondary coverage to national customers, as assigned
* Refer project management, including outsourcing coordination, to appropriate Operations resources
* Direct, plan and assist in customer recovery as appropriate
* Build and maintain a robust and accurate pipeline of business at established standards inside of the FXO customer relationship management (CRM) tool
* Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) system data, including daily activities and account updates
* Work and utilize the extensive FedEx sponsorship programs to host key clients and strengthen customer relationships
* Maximize the FedEx value delivered to each and every customer by working cross functionally within FXO, Services and the other FedEx Operating companies
* All other duties as needed or required

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS**:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* 5\+ years of business\-to\-business solutions selling experience required with a focus on prospecting new customers and developing existing business relationships
* Demonstrated business math and intermediate computer skills with MS Office
* High level of experience in sales planning, sales proposals, and selling the value propositions appropriate to corporate level customers and others in the organization
* Demonstrated understanding of sales financial targets/quotas with proven successful results
* Strong conceptual selling, presentation, closing and organizational skills
* Highly self\-motivated, with a strong appetite for learning
* Articulate; uses clear, convincing and tailored communication
* Proven selling skills and knowledge of value propositions
* Recognized flexible disposition; open to coaching and feedback
* Experience within the document solutions or product offerings industry, preferred but not required
* Experience utilizing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software programs, preferred
* Presents a personal professional image
* For new hires, must meet all FedEx Office employment qualifications in force at time of hiring
* For current FedEx Office team members, must meet hiring criteria for the position and transfer requirements as outlined in the Team Member Handbook

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**:

* Ability to travel as required in order to meet with customers, vendors, other team members, and/or other business necessities
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to maintain attention and concentration for extended periods of time
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to read and interpret documents and instructions from customers, vendors, and other team members
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and other team members
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to perform work activities requiring cooperation and instruction
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to function in a fast\-paced environment, under substantial pressure
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to work within the appropriate level of independence
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to report

jobs.title: Defense Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**The Company**
===============


Sofar is on a mission to connect the world's oceans.


We design, build, and deploy the largest privately owned network of marine sensors, combining oceanographic and underwater acoustic sensing to deliver the world's best marine weather forecasts and maritime domain awareness. Our data helps commercial customers increase efficiency and reduce emissions, while giving governments and defense stakeholders the tools to understand extreme weather, ocean conditions, and underwater acoustic activity in remote environments.


We live on Planet Ocean, and our goal is to create the ocean intelligence needed to ensure a sustainable and secure future.

**The Role**
------------


As **U.S. Federal Growth Lead**, you will lead the cross\-cutting activities that help Sofar identify, shape, capture, and win strategic opportunities across the U.S. federal government. Your portfolio will span defense and civilian agencies, with particular emphasis on maritime operations, environmental intelligence, weather and ocean data, and national security missions. The scope is focused on capture, growth, and execution within the **U.S. federal market**.


You will own the closely connected areas that drive U.S. federal and defense revenue: **business development**, **capture management, government affairs,** and **strategic partnerships**. You will translate customer demand and company capabilities into actionable capture strategies; develop relationships with policymakers, program offices, contracting organizations, prime contractors, and technology partners; and create viable pathways from early customer interest to funded federal programs.


This is not a purely strategic role \- you are expected to be able to get your hands dirty on customer engagements, proposals, and program execution. You will partner closely with other teams on proposal development and capture, program execution, and defense sales; and you will directly manage consultants and lobbyists. This is an integrated federal\-growth position for someone who can connect mission need, stakeholder support, acquisition strategy, funding, partners, and internal execution.


The role reports to the **Global Head of Government and Defense**.

**Impact You’ll Own**
---------------------

* **Capture:** Develop and execute capture strategies for Sofar’s highest\-priority U.S. federal opportunities across defense and civilian agencies from early qualification and shaping through acquisition strategy, teaming, proposal development, award, and transition to contract execution. Work with account leads to connect near\-term sales opportunities with longer\-term programs, contract vehicles, appropriations, and agency acquisition strategies.
* **Growth Metrics and Strategy:** Provide leadership with concise, decision\-ready assessments of pipeline health, capture progress, partner activity, government\-affairs priorities, risks, resource needs, and recommended actions.
* **Customer Engagement:** Represent Sofar at customer meetings, industry events, partner discussions, exercises, demonstrations, and other federal\-market engagements.
* **Government Affairs:** Lead Sofar’s U.S. federal government\-affairs execution in coordination with external advisors.
* **Proposals:** Partner with the government programs team on the development of capture materials, white papers, responses to requests for information, statements of work, ROMs, proposals, presentations, and other customer\-facing submissions.
* **Strategic Partnerships:** Build and manage relationships and teaming strategies with prime contractors and other partners that expand Sofar’s access, capabilities, and competitiveness.
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Collaborate across sales, product, engineering, legal, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership to ensure priority pursuits are both compelling to the customer and executable by Sofar.

**About You**
-------------


You are a determined, highly organized operator who knows how to move complex federal opportunities forward despite ambiguity. You can see the entire path from an operational need to a funded and executable contract—and identify what must happen next when that path is incomplete.


You understand that federal growth rarely comes from a single activity. Winning requires aligning the user, program office, acquisition community, funding source, policymakers, partners, internal stakeholders, and contracting mechanism. You are skilled at connecting those pieces while maintaining urgency, accountability, and attention to detail.


You are comfortable shifting between strategy and execution: briefing an executive on a capture decision, developing a teaming approach with a prime contractor, reviewing an agency budget, preparing for a congressional meeting, and driving follow\-up actions after a customer engagement. You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and consistently close loops.


You are also motivated by mission impact. You are excited about using novel ocean, weather, sensing, and decision\-support technologies to improve maritime awareness, operational effectiveness, safety, environmental intelligence, and national security.


We are open to a range of experience levels for this role. This is an incredible growth opportunity for a hungry early\-career (5\+ years of experience) federal business development operative (possibly a former proposal/capture strategist , deployment strategist, or Hill staffer) who is eager to expand their impact. We also recognize and respect the experience of tenured BD professionals who have spent 10\+ years navigating federal/defense acquisition and who are interested in applying their skillset to help advance an innovative ocean technology company.

* 5\+ years of experience in U.S. federal business development, capture management, government affairs, strategic partnerships, federal acquisition, or a related field, including demonstrated experience advancing

jobs.title: Multi-Platform Marketing Specialist, Telemundo Area de la Bahia 48
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world\-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad\-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry\-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations \& Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.


Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

 **Job Description**  

Telemundo 48 Área de la Bahía is looking for a creative, digitally savvy Multi\-Platform Marketing Specialist who understands how audiences discover, consume and share content today.


Reporting to the Senior Community and Marketing Director, this hands\-on role will help bring the Telemundo 48 brand to life across social, digital, streaming, broadcast and community platforms. The ideal candidate is a strong content creator and storyteller who can conceptualize, shoot, write, edit, design, publish and optimize engaging content, with a strong focus on social\-first storytelling, audience growth and culturally relevant content for the Bay Area Latino community.


This position works closely with Marketing, Community, News, Digital, Sales and other teams in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Create, shoot, produce and edit compelling social\-first content, including short\-form and vertical video, graphics, photos and other digital assets for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, streaming, web and other station platforms.
* Manage the publishing, scheduling and optimization of marketing, promotional and community content across social media platforms.
* Capture high\-quality photo and video content in the field using mobile devices and professional production equipment as appropriate.
* Write engaging, conversational and audience\-focused copy in Spanish and English, tailored to the voice, format and best practices of each platform.
* Collaborate with the Marketing and Community team and partners across News, Digital, Sales and other departments to develop creative that supports station brand, programming, audience growth, revenue and community initiatives.
* Collaborate with anchors and reporters to create engaging social\-first content that supports station marketing and community initiatives.
* Develop creative concepts and multiplatform campaigns around major station priorities, programming, tentpole events and community initiatives.
* Identify social trends, culturally relevant moments and emerging content formats that create opportunities for Telemundo 48 to connect with new and existing audiences.
* Monitor social performance and use analytics and audience insights to optimize content and inform future creative decisions.
* Support the Digital Editorial team as needed by creating, editing and publishing social\-first content around timely, trending and high\-interest stories.
* Use emerging digital and AI\-assisted tools, when appropriate and in accordance with company guidelines, to support ideation, creative development, production workflows and content optimization.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver high\-quality work under tight deadlines in a fast\-paced content environment.
* Support station and community events, including onsite content creation and social media coverage.
* Work flexible hours, including occasional nights, weekends and holidays, as business and event needs require.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications**

* Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages, including the ability to write engaging and conversational marketing and social media copy.
* 2\+ years of professional experience in social media, digital marketing, content creation, video production, communications or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience creating and editing short\-form video and social\-first content.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and emerging social platforms, including platform\-specific formats and best practices.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, AI-Native
jobs.description:
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
  

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
  

  

We are hiring a Business Operations Manager to run the business of Cloud Operations and SRE, and to work 1:1 with the VP who leads it. One role, two halves that reinforce each other: you own how the org plans, reports and follows through, and you own the executive’s time, attention and follow\-through as a system you design and continuously improve.
  

  

We are looking for someone who already runs their own stack of agents and automations, who treats “a human did this manually” as a bug, and who measures themselves by what moved forward — not by what got scheduled.
  

  

If you have been the person on your team quietly building the workflows everyone else asks to borrow, read on.
  

  

What This Role Actually Is
  

* A business operations owner. You run the planning and reporting spine of the org: goals and OKRs, the roadmap, the cross\-functional programs, and the metrics that say whether Cloud Operations and SRE are healthy. You know the numbers before anyone asks for them, and you chase down the ones that do not make sense.
* A program driver. For initiatives that cross teams, you own the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the uncomfortable status update. Nobody should have to ask “what happened with that?”
* An operator. You will run the operating cadence: staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles, offsites. You will run these end to end: agenda, pre\-reads, decisions captured, owners assigned, follow\-ups driven to closure.
* A force multiplier to the executive, not a filter. The executive support half of this job is a core part of it, not a legacy attachment. You will own the VP’s calendar, inbox, travel and follow\-through, and you will make decisions on their behalf inside clearly defined boundaries widening those boundaries as trust compounds. You understand what good looks like for implementing an agentic stack to be the filter, and the organizational change management necessary to drive the teams to that filter.
* An org operations partner. Headcount and requisition tracking, hiring loops, onboarding that does not depend on tribal knowledge, team communications, and offsites you own outright.
* An automation builder. Every recurring task you touch is a candidate for an agent. Weekly reports, status roll\-ups, meeting prep briefs, inbox triage and drafting, travel logistics, expense reconciliation, doc hygiene — you build it once, monitor it, and move on to the next thing. Your job is to work yourself out of your own to\-do list, repeatedly. There is plenty more to do after all of this is automated; it is why you are a force multiplier and an operator.
* A judgment layer. Automation is cheap; taste is not. You will know which emails only the executive can answer, which meeting genuinely needs 60 minutes, which “urgent” request can wait until Thursday, and which agent output is subtly wrong and must never go out the door.

  
* 5 or more years in business operations, program management, chief\-of\-staff or senior executive support roles, including direct experience supporting a senior executive, and at least some of it in a fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity environment (startup, scale\-up, or a team inside a larger company operating like one).
* Genuinely AI\-native. You use AI assistants and agentic tools every day, not occasionally. You can describe — in specifics — a workflow you automated, what broke, and how you fixed it. Prompting is not a party trick to you; it is how you work. Bonus points if you are well beyond prompting and operating with context and graph loop engineering.
* Hands\-on with agentic tooling. Personal AI agents and assistants for calendar, inbox and scheduling; general\-purpose assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) as daily drivers; and connective tissue between systems. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be unafraid of documentation and have a high level of taste.
* The ability to run a cadence and a program. Agendas, pre\-reads, decision logs, status that is honest when it is bad. You are comfortable holding senior people to commitments they made, in writing, in front of their peers.
* Comfort with numbers. You can build a reporting roll\-up, spot the metric that is lying, and explain a trend to leadership without dressing it up.
* Judgment under incomplete information, or with swinging\-door outcomes. You would rather make a reversible decision now than wait for permission.
* Instinctive discretion. You will sit close to board material, compensation, org changes and unannounced strategy. This is table stakes.

  

Nice to have:
  

* You have built something small and useful with low\-code tools — a script, a dashboard, a bot — because it was faster than asking.
* You have run a planning or OKR cycle for a technical org and lived with the result.
* You have been given scope beyond a traditional remit: a project, a budget, a vendor relationship, a team offsite you owned outright.
* Experience in an org where AI adoption was a stated strategy, not a pilot.
* Comfort with data infrastructure, energy, or high\-growth technical businesses.
* You have opinions about which tools are overrated.
* You know how to speak clanker.

* You want a stable, predictable week.
* You prefer to be told exactly what to do.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager, Special Projects, NA
jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


**Position Description:**

**This role will be based in Santa Clara California, Sparks, NV, San Antonio, TX, Reno, NV following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

* Vantage is looking for an Assistant Project Manager to assist the Special Projects team and Project Managers to drive success on new and ongoing construction projects.
* The position covers all aspects of a construction project. Areas of expertise that require minimal oversight and autonomy in the following areas:
* RFP development and overall project budgeting
* Pre\-bid oversight and coordination assistance
* Assist managing all design phases and documents
* Assist managing, coordinating and supervising design\-build contractors and vendors
* Assist and/or coordinate with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Assist with oversight of physical construction activities
* Participation in commissioning
* Assist, manage and own project close outs: Punch list, as\-builds, warranties, OEM, etc.
**Essential Job Functions:**

* Report to and assist Vantage Special Projects team and assigned manager.
* Proficient at taking initiative, problem solving, time management, and thinking outside the box.
* Gather vendor proposals, invoicing documents and ensure vendor deliverables are delivered in a timely manner.
* Manage individual tasks throughout the construction process including submittals, RFI process, drawings and safety reporting.
* Proficient understanding of contract types; i.e., GMP, Lump Sum, NTE, etc.
* Proficient understanding of invoicing; i.e., lien waivers, pay applications, retention, etc.
* Proficient in leading OAC meetings, coordination meetings, and facilitating stakeholder meetings.
* Coordinate VDC led meetings, manage meeting minutes and drive actions to closure.
* Oversee OFCI equipment release, delivery, deficiencies, startup and commissioning.
* Ensure project compliance, track construction progress via daily logs, site inspections and QA/QC.
* Manage project close\-out and documentation.
 **Duties:**

* Manage small to medium sized projects with Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager oversight.
* Occasionally, based on Assistant Project Manager’s experience, readiness and learning development; individual may be included in larger more technical projects to assist Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager.
* Assist and or manage multiple projects concurrently and projects in various locations.
* Coordinate internal alignment on project document reviews, budgeting and financial exercises and purchase order management.
* Enforce project quality controls and safety programs through an in\-depth understanding of the partner contracts and design docs.

jobs.description:
**The School**
--------------


As New York City’s only charter high school that is both a transfer school and a fully embedded community school in partnership with The Door. BSA serves over\-age, under\-credited students who deserve rigorous academic pathways alongside comprehensive wraparound support. The Operations Coordinator will serve as the dynamic leader of our non\-academic functions, ensuring a welcoming main office experience while managing the critical compliance, logistical, and purchasing systems that power BSA.




**The Moment**
--------------


BSA stands at a pivotal inflection point and is focused on resetting academic expectations. We are in an active turnaround phase focused on stabilization, systems\-building, and cultural reset. Our Operations Coordinator will be a responsible member of a dedicated team focused on systems that are compliant, welcoming, and operationally seamless. Together, we have a powerful opportunity to transform BSA for the students and families we serve.




**The Opportunity**
-------------------


BSA’s Operations Coordinator will have the opportunity to:

* **Build.** Establish, organize, and maintain highly efficient school supply, purchasing, and tracker systems that keep the school's nonacademic resources seamless and within budget.
* **Lead.** Coordinate daily main office operations, manage staffing needs, and ensure a highly welcoming and supportive environment for students, families, and visitors.
* **Reimagine.** Create innovative, streamlined logistics for school trips and events, demonstrating how seamless behind\-the\-scenes support enriches the community school experience.
* **Integrate.** Align compliance efforts with school\-wide safety and student records standards, working closely with NYC and Charter agencies to keep the school fully prepared and compliant.
* **Transform.** Partner closely with the Director of Operations to drive a successful organizational turnaround, turning operational challenges into structured, repeatable successes.

-------------------------

* Oversees daily main office operations, ensuring a welcoming environment and exceptional customer service delivery for students, families, and staff.

* Manages official enrollment, discharges, and student daily attendance according to NYC guidelines utilizing ATS.

* Supports the Director of Operations in executing emergency compliance readiness, including Evacuation, Shelter\-In, and Lockdown drills.

* Direct experience working in an NYC charter school, NYCDOE public school, transfer school, or a non\-

jobs.description:

------------


Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting\-edge AI\-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.


As trailblazers in end\-to\-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post\-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.


Our vision extends beyond mere problem\-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.


Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking a part\-time Office \& Events Coordinator to run our Williamsburg HQ and build the in\-office culture that comes with it. You'll keep the space running smoothly and own an events calendar people actually look forward to.


This role is approximately 15\-20 hours per week, onsite at least 3 days a week. We're flexible on how the hours are structured.


Below is a sample of what this role may include. Ultimately, the right candidate will have a "can do" attitude and is willing to help across a wide variety of operational and culture\-building activities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

*Office Management*

* Keep the office stocked: snacks, beverages, and office supplies
* Strategize and implement ways to keep the space organized — sourcing storage solutions, closet organizers, and systems that help the office stay tidy as we grow
* Track inventory of work accessories, and stationery
* Coordinate building access for new and existing employees, and serve as the point of contact with building management
* Ensure every new hire has a desk ready on day one, greet visitors, and be the go\-to person for all in\-office questions
* Own vendor relationships

*Events \& Culture*

* Fully own the Axion events calendar
* Curate fun, engaging, team\-building activities that spearhead our in\-office culture and give people real reasons to be here
* Organize our quarterly happy hours, provide support for individual teams in planning their own team events
* Lead larger team celebrations and our annual company\-wide events, including the holiday party and summer event

**Requirements**
----------------

* An attitude of "no task is too small" — we are looking for someone who is happy to roll up their sleeves and do what needs to be done
* An upbeat, friendly presence. You set the tone for the office, and people should be glad to see you
* A self\-starter who takes on initiatives without being asked — you see what needs improving and go do it
* 1\+ years in office management, workplace operations, events, or hospitality
* Experience planning events, from small team happy hours to company\-wide celebrations
* Comfort managing vendors and working within a budget
* Strong organizational skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and a high level of discretion
* Proficient in Google Workspace, Slack, and conferencing tools like Zoom
* Able to be onsite in Williamsburg at least 3 days per week

**Who You Are**
---------------


You're an operator who thrives in fast\-moving, high\-accountability environments. You take pride in getting things done — thoughtfully, efficiently, and without drama. You're energized by ambiguity and comfortable flexing between planning and execution.


You bring genuine warmth to a room. You notice when someone new looks lost, you remember what the team liked about the last event, and you care about the details that make a workplace feel good. You're low\-ego but high\-agency: you don't need constant direction, you create momentum, and you take ownership for outcomes.

**How We Operate**
------------------


We move fast, work smart, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Axion isn't a 9–5 — it's a place for people who take pride in their craft and are motivated by meaningful work. We're highly collaborative and connected throughout the day, mostly over Slack, and we share feedback often so context and decisions flow freely. We push hard but don't glorify burnout — we're in this for the long game.

**We**
------

* **Leave ego at the door.** Titles don't define value; contribution does. Ideas win on merit.
* **Bias toward action.** We iterate fast and favor progress over perfection.
* **Communicate with clarity.** Direct, transparent, and always in service of the mission.
* **Act like owners.** Everyone is accountable for outcomes, not just tasks.


If you want to help shape a company redefining how manufacturing operates, and you thrive in a culture that rewards ownership, speed, and candor, you'll feel at home here.

**What We Offer:**
------------------

* Work with cutting\-edge AI technology making a tangible impact in manufacturing
* Collaborative, mission\-driven team and supportive leadership
* Generous time off
* Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
* Lunch stipend…. And much more

jobs.title: Temporary Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT SOTHEBY'S**



Established in 1744, Sotheby's promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby's and Concierge. Sotheby's Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby's new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

**THE ROLE**



Sotheby's is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Logistics Coordinator to support the movement, intake, and tracking of property across our three New York sites: Long Island City (LIC), York Avenue, and the Breuer Building. This role blends logistics coordination with registrar\-adjacent responsibilities and plays a vital part in maintaining the accuracy, condition, and timely handling of property throughout its exhibition lifecycle—from initial transfers to return.



The Temporary Logistics Coordinator will assist with loop truck scheduling, coordinate property transfers for exhibitions and Private Sale, book the Breuer dock, and perform property intake and "lite" condition verification. The ideal candidate will be proactive, flexible, and deeply collaborative across departments.



This is a 3\-month contract.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**



Working in collaboration with the Logistics Manager and Supervisor:


**Cross\-Site Property Tracking \& Coordination**


* Maintain detailed records of all property transferring from LIC and York Avenue to the Breuer for exhibitions and Private Sale appointments.
* Track piece count, tagging, condition status, and documentation to ensure accuracy and accountability.
* Coordinate return transfers following exhibitions, reconciling paperwork and ensuring safe repackaging.
* Communicate regularly with Inventory Control, Registrar, and Specialist teams to ensure clear handoffs and status updates.
* Ensure works are handled according to Sotheby's safety and security protocols.
* Support Art Handlers and Project Leads with information, access, and updated schedules.
* Partner with cross\-departmental teams to support pre\-sale activities across multiple locations, aligning logistics and workflow to meet shifting priorities and deadlines.


**Property Intake \& Condition Verification (Registrar Support)**


* Conduct "lite" condition verification upon arrival of works at the Breuer or York Avenue.
* Confirm piece count, tagging, pre\-existing conditions, and accuracy of shipping documentation.
* Photograph incoming works and maintain visual condition records in internal systems.
* Collaborate with the Registrar and Inventory teams to reconcile discrepancies and ensure audit readiness.
* Cross\-train in other Logistics areas and provide support across Registrar functions as needed, promoting operational flexibility and a team\-first mindset.


**Loop Truck \& Transfer Scheduling**


* Assist the Logistics Manager in scheduling Sotheby's loop truck for ad hoc and sale\-specific transfers between LIC, York Avenue, and the Breuer.
* Ensure proper documentation, timing, and communication of all scheduled transfers.
* Monitor delivery timelines and escalate delays or conflicts as needed.
* Maintain detailed records of all property transferring from LIC and York Avenue to the Breuer for exhibitions and Private Sale appointments.
