jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth\-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It's hard to believe that it's 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We're here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

### **About the role**



As a Mid Market Account Manager, you will be a member of our client\-facing team \- responsible for the commercial relationship with our customers (Property Management Companies) within our Mid Market segment. You'll own and operate a book of business where consistency, prioritization, and process discipline matter as much as relationship depth. This is a partner role \- you will act as the customer's advisor and point of contact \- to maintain, retain, and grow the business relationship at scale.


### **What you'll do**


**Portfolio Management \& Prioritization**


* Own and operate a high\-volume book of business, prioritizing your time based on account health, engagement signals, and revenue opportunity rather than applying a uniform cadence to every account
* Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene \- accurate account data, activity logging, and pipeline/renewal tracking across the full portfolio
* Identify at\-risk accounts early using usage and engagement data, and escalate or intervene before renewal risk becomes churn


**Relationship Management \& Engagement**


* Establish and maintain relationships with day\-to\-day and senior stakeholders across your portfolio
* Run structured, efficient touchpoints (e.g., QBRs, check\-ins) calibrated to account tier rather than a one\-size\-fits\-all high\-touch model
* Act as the primary point of contact for your accounts, looping in specialists or leadership for higher\-complexity escalations
* Attend industry events and conduct on\-site visits selectively, prioritizing your highest\-opportunity or highest\-risk accounts \- at this volume, travel is the exception rather than the default


**Commercial Execution**


* Execute commercial negotiations efficiently and accurately across a large account count
* Identify and act on upsell/cross\-sell opportunities surfaced through data and playbooks, applying repeatable plays rather than building bespoke account strategy for every account
* Contribute to and help refine the playbooks, segmentation logic, and tooling that the Mid Market motion runs on as the segment matures at Flex

### **Key qualifications**


* Account Management Experience: 2\-4\+ years in Account Management or Customer Success, ideally managing a book of business at volume (multiple concurrent accounts, not a small handful)
* Experience owning renewals and standard commercial negotiations; comfortable operating within defined playbooks and pricing parameters rather than bespoke deal structuring
* Process Orientation: Strong organizational and prioritization skills \- proven ability to triage a large portfolio and direct time to where it has the most impact
* Data\-Driven: Comfortable using account health, usage, and engagement signals to identify risk and opportunity, and to decide where limited time is best spent
* Strong Communication Skills: High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly and efficiently across a high volume of relationships
* Tech Proficiency: Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM is a plus; experience with customer success or health\-scoring tooling is a plus
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams
* Self Starter: Comfortable operating in a segment where process, tooling, and playbooks are still maturing, and willing to help build them
* Quick Learner: Ability to adapt, learn, and iterate swiftly within the rapid changes in the PropTech/FinTech landscape. Comfortable with ambiguity and a test\-and\-learn mindset
* T.O.E: Last, but certainly not least, Team Over Everything. Our positive, team first culture is everything here at Flex. This role requires an even temperament that is always willing to put the team ahead of individual recognition.

### **Life at Flex**



We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.


**Offices**



Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on\-site expectations of 2\-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.


**Benefits**



For full\-time U.S. employees we offer:


* Competitive medical, dental, and vision
* Company equity
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Unlimited paid time off \+ 13 company paid holidays
* Parental leave
* Free Flex subscription


 For full\-time non\-U.S. employees, we offer:


* Competitive compensation \+ company equity
* Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: AVP, Sales Operations
jobs.description:
Richemont, one of the world leaders in the luxury sector, has various Houses specializing in jewelry, watches and high\-end accessories. Each Maison proudly embodies a tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont strives to preserve the heritage and identity specific to each of them. At the same time, we are committed to innovating and designing new products in line with the values of our Houses, through a process of permanent creativity.


**About the Role**

We are seeking for an accomplished and forward\-thinking Associate Vice President, Watches \& Jewelry Sales Operations to oversee sales operations across North America.


You will lead a high\-performing team responsible for ensuring flawless product flows to the stores, for both retail and wholesale.


You will oversee end\-to\-end sales operations, distribution flows and logistics coordination, partnering closely with boutiques, external partners, supply chain planning and logistics.


You will drive operational excellence, in a highly dynamic environment, and play a central role in advancing our sales operations capabilities to support future growth, develop our teams, and deliver a best\-in\-class experience to our clients, boutiques and partners.


This role requires a highly organized, customer\-focused leader with strong analytical capabilities and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced luxury environment.


**What You'll Do**

***Lead Sales Operations***

You will manage the Sales Operations function across North America, making sure the right processes, tools and systems are in place to help boutiques and external partners achieve strong commercial results and deliver an exceptional client experience.


You will foster a culture of operational excellence and improve relentlessly the performance of our sales operations.


Your responsibilities include:


* Lead and optimize distribution flows across North America, for retail and wholesale channels.
* Coordinate client firm orders with boutiques, external partners and commercial teams.
* Manage back\-order portfolio and delivery prioritization.
* Oversee consignments throughout their lifecycle.
* Coordinate buybacks and product returns.
* Support product allocation and operational execution for commercial and marketing events.
* Coordinate physical flows of products with Richemont logistics teams: from distribution centers to boutiques, external partners and clients, and from boutique to boutique.
* Collaborate with Richemont to ensure timely and compliant deliveries.
* Monitor logistics performance.
* Conduct stock rebalancing initiatives between boutiques.
* Coordinate purchase order creation for new product launches.
* Monitor and ensure successful fulfillment of novelty collections and strategic launches.
* Ensure timely investigation, resolution, and reporting of claims: overpacks, shortpacks and inventory discrepancies.

***Lead Transformation***

Our business and the desirability of our Maison continue to grow, and we develop our clienteling activities, with a strong emphasis on the highest price points. Therefore, the orchestration of the product flows and the management of the firm orders and waiting lists is highly critical and has to be scaled up.


In partnership with the Operations Excellence Team, you will:


* Simplify and standardize operational processes.
* Build next\-generation operational capabilities.
* Increase automation through digital tools and system enhancements.
* Develop advanced dashboards and KPIs to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of operational excellence.
* Lead change through communication, collaboration, and training, ensuring strong adoption across boutiques and corporate teams.

**Who You Are**

You are an inspiring leader who combines strong business acumen with deep sales operations expertise. You thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy solving complex operational challenges, and are passionate about developing people and building collaborative partnerships across global organizations.


**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Supply Chain, Merchandising or Retail Operations.
* Passion for delivering exceptional client experience with a customer\-first mindset.
* Demonstrated success leading and developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to partner seamlessly with global headquarters and cross\-functional teams across an international organization.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical mindset with advanced experience leveraging data to support business decisions.
* Experience developing business intelligence dashboards and performance metrics (Looker preferred).
* SAP proficiency.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in luxury, watches, jewelry, fashion, or premium consumer goods.
* Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued: Celonis, Microsoft Power Automate, Pega.

**Location**

This is a full\-time position based in New York City, with regular travel throughout North America.


**Salary Range:** $190,000\-$230,000

**Social Media Manager**


Mellon Foundation (“Foundation”) believes that the arts and humanities are where we express our complex humanity, and we believe that everyone deserves the beauty, transcendence, and freedom to be found there. The Mellon Foundation's team of communications professionals are responsible for building and stewarding the Foundation brand, telling its story, and driving outreach and engagement efforts both internally and externally. Our work strives to:

* Understanding of basic SEO and metadata best practices

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
***Start your tech sales career with people who actually want to teach you.***



We're hiring early\-career folks who are curious, coachable, and ready to learn how modern enterprise sales really works. You don't need a sales background — you need to be sharp, willing to pick up the phone, and excited to build something. We'll handle the rest.


**The role, in plain terms**



You'll be the first person from ComplyAdvantage that a potential customer talks to. That means researching companies, figuring out who the right person to reach is, and then actually reaching out — by phone, email, LinkedIn, or in person at industry events — to book a meeting with one of our account executives. It's the front door of the sales process, and it matters.



It's also the role where most great enterprise sales careers begin.


**What your day looks like**



You'll spend your time researching accounts and forming a real point of view on what's happening in their world, then reaching out to senior decision\-makers at companies. You'll work inbound leads that come in, dig into what those prospects actually need, and prep meetings so your account executives walk in ready. You'll join industry events, build a personal brand on LinkedIn, and get smarter about financial crime, compliance, and regtech every single week.


**What we'll teach you**



We've built a Go\-To\-Market team that takes training seriously — not as a one\-week onboarding then sink\-or\-swim, but as an ongoing thing. You'll learn a structured sales playbook that's been refined over years, get coaching from experienced reps and managers, and build genuine expertise in a complex, interesting industry. The BDRs who do well here move into Account Executive, Customer Success, Marketing, and Operations roles. We want this to be your launchpad.


**You might be a great fit if**



You're naturally curious and like understanding how things work. You're not afraid to start a conversation with someone senior — or you're willing to get comfortable with it. You take feedback well and actually apply it. You want to be good at something hard, and you're patient enough to put in the reps. A background in sales isn't required — strong candidates have come from hospitality, retail, campus leadership, athletics, customer service, internships, and plenty of other places.


**Basic qualifications**


* At least one (1\) year of work experience in a sales, customer\-facing, or professional role. Internships, part\-time jobs, on\-campus leadership roles, hospitality, retail, and customer service all count.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the US without current or future sponsorship.


**What's in it for you?**


* Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building
* Unlimited Time Off Policy\- A work\-life balance and focus on our well\-being are critical to keeping us performing at our best
* Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development
* Budget to set up your home office upon joining
* Parental leave and childcare benefits
* Life Insurance to protect your loved ones
* Medical (100%), Dental (90%), and Vision (80%) contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) to allow you to use tax free dollars for healthcare or day care related expenses
* 401k Contribution
* Financial Perks (Financial Advice, PerkSpot discounts, Pet Insurance discounts, Travel assistance)
* Pre\-Tax transit benefits


**Ready?**



If you've read this far and something in it clicked, apply. We'd rather hear from someone who's curious and a little nervous than someone who's perfectly polished.


*The base salary range for this role is $60,000 to $67,000 \+ commission, equity, and US benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skills.*

**About us:**



Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime.



By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.



More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end\-to\-end platform and the world's most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full\-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.



ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj\-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re\-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our Strategic Plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.


About Georgia Tech


Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.
  

Georgia Tech's Mission and Values


Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:


1\. Students are our top priority.


2\. We strive for excellence.


3\. We thrive on diversity.


4\. We celebrate collaboration.


5\. We champion innovation.


6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.


7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.


8\. We act ethically.


9\. We are responsible stewards.


Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.


**Job Summary**

Plan and coordinate the assigned department capital projects to ensure they are completed according to assigned unit standards, contract specifications and schedule. Collaborate with unit leadership to advance the unit master plan.

This position will typically advise and counsel: Assigned Department Staff, Infrastructure and Sustainability Partners, and contractors

assigned units' capital project requests
  

  

**Job Duty 2 \-**
  

Oversee unit's lifecycle replacement schedule for flooring, paint, and lighting in assigned buildings
  

  

**Job Duty 3 \-**
  

Perform other related job duties assigned
  

  

**Job Duty 4 \-**
  

Compile and maintain project schedule and milestones for projects from concept stage, through design and construction, to final punch completion. Track and communicate project updates and impacts. Advance coordination of projects with unit leaders, stakeholders, and campus partners
  

  

**Job Duty 5 \-**
  

Coordinate with architects, engineers, contractors, Institute partners and unit leaders and stakeholders in the execution of assigned projects

Develop Scope of Work (SOW) and conduct pre\-construction meetings; meet with and review project requirements with contractor representatives; review estimates/proposal, finalize quotes \& issue purchase orders

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Park Schools – Atlanta, GA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday  

About Park Schools  

Park Schools is a Montessori\-inspired early childhood education center serving children from **6 weeks to 5 years old**. Our approach combines **Montessori principles, S.T.E.A.M. education, hands\-on learning, and enrichment experiences** to support each child’s academic, social, emotional, and developmental growth.  

We are looking for an organized, energetic, and dependable **Program Coordinator** to help coordinate school programs, special activities, events, and day\-to\-day program operations.  

Position Overview  

The Program Coordinator plays an important role in ensuring Park Schools’ programs and activities are organized, engaging, and successfully implemented.  

This position works closely with school leadership, teachers, staff, families, and outside partners to coordinate enrichment programs, school events, special activities, and other initiatives that enhance the student and family experience.  

The ideal candidate is **highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects at once**. Experience in early childhood education, school administration, program coordination, or a related environment is preferred.  

Key Responsibilities  

* Coordinate and support school programs, enrichment activities, special events, and family engagement initiatives
* Develop and maintain program calendars, schedules, timelines, and activity plans
* Coordinate with teachers and school leadership to ensure programs align with classroom needs and school goals
* Communicate program information, schedules, reminders, and updates to families and staff
* Assist with planning seasonal events, celebrations, field trips, workshops, and other school activities
* Coordinate with vendors, community partners, instructors, and other outside providers when needed
* Track registrations, participation, attendance, supplies, and other program\-related information
* Prepare materials, resources, and supplies needed for programs and events
* Help ensure activities are age\-appropriate, organized, safe, and consistent with Park Schools’ educational philosophy
* Support student transitions and daily school operations when needed
* Maintain organized program records, documents, and reports
* Collect feedback from families, teachers, and staff to help improve programs
* Assist with promoting upcoming programs and events to current and prospective families
* Identify opportunities for new enrichment activities and programs
* Collaborate with school leadership on program improvements and new initiatives
* Provide administrative and operational support as needed

Qualifications  

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred
* Previous experience in **program coordination, education, childcare, school administration, event coordination, or a related field** preferred
* Experience working in an early childhood or Montessori environment is a plus
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects, schedules, and deadlines
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through
* Comfortable communicating professionally with parents, teachers, vendors, and school leadership
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and other common administrative tools
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with a team
* Positive, professional, and solution\-oriented attitude
* Genuine interest in supporting children, families, and educators

What We’re Looking For  

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just wait for instructions. Our ideal Program Coordinator can **anticipate needs, stay ahead of deadlines, communicate clearly, and take ownership of programs from planning through completion**.  

You should enjoy bringing ideas to life while making sure the details behind the scenes are handled smoothly.  

Why Join Park Schools?  

At Park Schools, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful programs that directly impact children and families. You’ll work alongside a collaborative team committed to creating an engaging, nurturing, and high\-quality early childhood learning environment.  

**Apply today to join Park Schools as our Program Coordinator!**  

Park Schools is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes qualified applicants from all backgrounds.

**Position Summary:**


The Recovery Account Manager is Responsible for communicating with customers and third parties by phone and written correspondence to collect and resolve charged\-off deficiency balance accounts, manage driving skip cases, locate customers and/or collateral, negotiate resolutions, and document account activity while ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Communicate with customers and third parties through telephone and written correspondence to resolve charged\-off deficiency balances, driving skip accounts, and other recovery\-related matters.

* Verify customer identity by adhering to established safeguard and authentication procedures and safeguard confidential consumer information, including Social Security numbers, dates of birth, and other protected data.
* Accurately document customer communications, payment arrangements, account activity, and recovery efforts within the collection system while maintaining compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and applicable laws.
* Conduct all customer interactions in a professional, courteous, and respectful manner, consistently achieving established performance objectives and completing additional duties and special projects as assigned.

**The Opportunity**

Canopy Remodeling is looking for a **Field Marketing Manager** to build and lead our door\-to\-door field marketing operation in the Atlanta market.

This is not a position for someone looking to inherit a large, established team and simply maintain it. We are looking for a **builder**—someone who can recruit talented people, develop them into high\-performing field marketers, create a winning team culture, and consistently generate high\-quality opportunities for our sales organization.

You’ll have significant ownership over the Atlanta field marketing operation and the opportunity to put your fingerprints on how the team is built.

If you’re competitive, energetic, highly accountable, and know how to get people performing at a high level, we want to talk.

**What You’ll Own**

· Recruit, interview, hire, and onboard D2D field marketers

· Build and grow the Atlanta field marketing team

· Train new hires on canvassing, homeowner engagement, lead qualification, and appointment setting

· Lead daily meetings, ongoing training, and performance coaching

· Develop team leaders and future managers

· Establish a high\-energy, competitive, professional team culture

· Manage territories, schedules, and daily field activity

· Work alongside the team in the field when necessary to coach, demonstrate, and drive results

· Hold team members accountable to performance and professionalism standards

· Partner closely with Sales to improve appointment quality and lead outcomes

· Track performance, identify problems, and make adjustments quickly

· Represent the Canopy brand professionally in the communities we serve

**How We Measure Success**

We aren’t interested in generating appointments simply to inflate activity numbers. A successful field marketing team creates **quality, high\-intent opportunities** that result in **winnable opportunities for our Sales Consultants**.

You’ll have visibility into the entire downstream performance of the opportunities your team creates, including revenue generated.

***Quality matters. Results matter.***

**Who We’re Looking For**

The ideal candidate has successfully managed a canvassing, field marketing, or door\-to\-door team, preferably within home improvement, remodeling, roofing, windows, solar, pest control, or another in\-home sales environment.

We will also consider an exceptional team leader who is ready to take the next step into full management responsibility.

More importantly, we’re looking for someone who is:

· A strong recruiter who can identify and attract talented people

· A high\-energy leader who people want to follow

· Competitive and motivated by measurable results

· Comfortable holding people accountable

· An effective trainer and field coach

· Highly professional and capable of representing our brand well

· High in personal integrity

· Organized enough to manage people, territories, schedules, and performance

· Entrepreneurial and comfortable operating with significant autonomy

· Willing to roll up their sleeves and do what is necessary to build a successful team

**Your First 90 Days**

We aren’t looking for someone to spend their first three months observing from the sidelines.

Your mandate is straightforward:

**Outside Sales is your customer. Build your team and get our Consultants in the home!**

Learn the Canopy system, recruit aggressively, establish expectations, develop your people, get into the field, and begin building a field marketing organization capable of producing consistent, high\-quality opportunities for our Atlanta sales team.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

· $100k\-$150k\+ Year\-One OTE

· Base salary plus performance\-based commission

· W2 employment

· 401(k) plan available

· Two weeks paid time off

· Significant performance upside as the team grows

*This is a non\-benefited W2 position.*

**Growth Opportunity**

Canopy is a growing home remodeling company with aggressive expansion plans.

For the right person, this role can become much bigger than managing a single field marketing team.

Strong performance can create opportunities to move into **senior field marketing leadership, multi\-market management, new\-market expansion, or leadership positions elsewhere within the organization.**

We believe in giving talented people responsibility, measuring them by results, and creating opportunities for high performers to grow as quickly as the company does.

**The Bottom Line**

We’re looking for someone who wants to ***build something***.

You’ll have leadership support, recruiting resources, significant authority, and room to make the Atlanta field marketing operation your own.

What you do with that opportunity is up to you.

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
Description:
**Job Summary**


The Community Manager is responsible for the overall management and operation of an assigned property. The role includes ensuring property performance meets MMG Management’s standards and expectations in terms of occupancy, financial objectives, resident satisfaction, and overall maintenance. The Community Manager leads the on\-site team, oversees daily operations, and ensures the property runs smoothly while adhering to MMG’s mission and core values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Property Operations Management:
* Oversee daily operations of the property, ensuring compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Conduct regular property inspections to ensure a high standard of cleanliness, curb appeal, and maintenance.
* Conduct regular file audits to ensure and maintain compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Ensure completion of daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual tasks.
* Address resident concerns and resolve issues promptly and professionally to maintain a high level of resident satisfaction.
* Proactively develop solution plans for any identified problems or inefficiencies related to property operations, maintenance, or resident issues.
* Ensure timely and efficient execution of approved plans, following up on progress and making adjustments as necessary to meet property performance goals.


2\. Leasing \& Occupancy Management:

* Manage the leasing process to ensure high occupancy rates.
* Monitor market trends and recommend competitive rental pricing to maximize occupancy.
* Oversee and support leasing team efforts in handling inquiries, conducting tours, and securing new leases.
* Ensure timely processing and management of lease renewals and notices to vacate.


3\. Financial Management:

* Assist in development of and manage the property’s budget, ensuring financial goals are achieved.
* Monitor rent collections, delinquencies, and accounts receivable, acting to minimize loss and optimize revenue.
* Review financial reports, including rent rolls, profit and loss statements, and expense tracking, ensuring accuracy and performance alignment with company and ownership goals.
* Ensure invoices and bills are received accurately within 48 hours of services rendered or per scheduled timeline.
* Timely and accurate invoice and bill entry into property management software within 24 hours of receipt of invoices or billing statements.


4\. Maintenance \& Vendor Management:

* Coordinate and oversee maintenance requests, ensuring timely response and quality workmanship.
* Develop and maintain vendor relationships, negotiating contracts for services such as landscaping, cleaning, and repairs.
* Ensure preventive maintenance programs are implemented and executed consistently to maintain property value.
* Follow vendor selection and set up policies and procedures


5\. Leadership \& Team Growth:

* Provide leadership, ongoing training, and direction to the on\-site leasing and maintenance teams.
* Recruit, train, and onboard new team members in coordination with MMG Policies and standards.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and ensure ongoing training and development.
* Foster a positive team environment, promoting MMG’s values of employee engagement and development.
* Prepare staff schedules to ensure optimized daily operations functionality and goals.
* Regularly conduct staff meetings discussing and implementing goals, job duties, achievements, and needs.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of employee paid hours, commission, bonuses, and other staff compensation items.


6\. Marketing \& Residential Retention:

* Develop and implement marketing strategies to attract new residents and retain current tenants.
* Organize and participate in resident events and initiatives to foster a sense of community and improve resident retention.
* Maintain a professional and approachable presence at the property to ensure excellent customer service and community relations.
* Become active in local business community to develop positive rapport.


7\. Compliance \& Risk Management:

* Ensure the property complies with Fair Housing laws and all other applicable regulations.
* Manage risk by adhering to safety protocols and addressing safety concerns on the property.
* Handle legal issues such as evictions, lease violations, and legal notices in accordance with MMG and local regulations with communication and collaboration with Regional Director and Portfolio Manager.


8\. Reporting \& Communication:

* Prepare and submit accurate and timely weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance activities, and other key metrics by deadlines.
* Maintain open communication with the Regional Property Director and Portfolio Manager, providing updates on property performance, challenges, and successes.

**Work Context:**


Communication:

* Required to frequently communicate efficiently, accurately, and timely via email, phone, or specified applications.


 Role Importance:

* Community Managers play a crucial role in overseeing all aspects of a financial asset while maintaining resident satisfaction. They are responsible for managing budgets, supervising staff, and ensuring the properties under their care are well\-maintained and profitable.


 Responsibility for Others:

* Community Managers are responsible for their teams. They are to uphold policy, assess deficiencies, ensure proper training, completion of tasks, and hold teams accountable for shortcomings.


Work Setting:

* Community Manager is an in\-office position to be done at a specific assigned location.


 Job Hazards:

* Possible hazardous conditions include but are not limited to: disgruntled tenants, disgruntled employee, mold, mildew, extreme temperatures.


 Work Attire:

* Business casual attire require. Please see personal appearance policy for specifications.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Social Media Manager who understands restaurants, creates content that gets attention, and can prove their work gets results. This is not a position for someone looking to build their first portfolio or gain their first restaurant client. We’re looking for someone with hands\-on restaurant social media management experience, a strong creative eye, and a proven track record of measurable results.

What You’ll Do

* Manage social media accounts for restaurant and hospitality clients
* Develop and execute social media strategies specifically for restaurants
* Create, coordinate, and/or oversee photo and video content
* Plan and maintain content calendars
* Capture on\-site content at client locations
* Develop creative concepts for Reels, TikToks, Stories, posts, and other social content
* Stay current with social media trends, sounds, formats, and platform changes
* Write engaging captions and create content designed to drive customer action
* Monitor analytics and adjust strategy based on performance
* Track key metrics including reach, engagement, views, follower growth, website traffic, and other relevant KPIs
* Coordinate content around promotions, events, menu launches, holidays, and other restaurant\-specific opportunities

RESTAURANT EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

You must have previous experience specifically managing social media for restaurants, bars, cafés, hospitality groups, or other food \& beverage businesses. We are not looking for someone whose experience is primarily:

* Personal social media
* Influencer accounts
* General social media with no restaurant experience
* Posting content without developing the strategy
* Managing accounts without tracking performance

We want someone who understands the restaurant industry and knows how to create content that gets people to stop scrolling, visit, order, book, or engage.

YOUR PORTFOLIO IS REQUIRED

DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO. We are intentionally requiring a portfolio because we want to eliminate applicants who are simply applying to every available position. Your portfolio must demonstrate real restaurant social media work that you personally managed or contributed to.

We want to see:

* Restaurant accounts you have managed
* Examples of your actual work
* Your specific role and responsibilities
* Examples of successful content
* Campaigns or strategies you implemented
* Trackable analytics and performance data
* Before\-and\-after results when available
* Reach, impressions, engagement, views, follower growth, website traffic, or other relevant KPIs

Screenshots of analytics are strongly encouraged. A portfolio consisting solely of attractive posts without any indication of performance will not be considered sufficient. We want to know: What did you do?  
Why did you do it?  
And what happened as a result?

ON\-SITE CONTENT REQUIREMENT

Although this position does not require you to live locally, you must live close enough to the client location(s) to physically visit the businesses when required. You will be required to be physically present at client locations for content creation a minimum of 2 scheduled days per month.

These on\-site days will be used to:

* Capture photo and video content
* Film Reels/TikToks
* Capture behind\-the\-scenes content
* Highlight food, drinks, staff, atmosphere, and experiences
* Capture timely content that cannot be created remotely
* Stay familiar with the restaurant, team, brand, and customer experience

If you are not within a reasonable traveling distance of the client location(s) and cannot commit to a minimum of 2 on\-site content days per month, this position will not be a fit.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE REQUIRED

Restaurant marketing doesn’t always happen from 9\-5\. You must be willing to work flexible hours based on client needs and content opportunities. This may include occasional:

* Evenings
* Weekends
* Special events
* Grand openings
* Menu launches

**Social Media Manager – Serenity Healthcare**

**Location:** Atlanta, GA (Sandy Springs) \| In\-office  

**Team:** Marketing  

**Reports to**: VP of Marketing  

**Type:** Full\-time, exempt

 **About the role:**


Serenity Healthcare is looking for a **Social Media Manager** to own and grow our social presence across key platforms.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who understands how to turn ideas into content that earns attention, builds trust and helps people understand the care Serenity provides.


You will own the day\-to\-day social media program, from content planning and creation through publishing, community management, influencer partnerships, reporting and optimization. You’ll work closely with the broader marketing team to bring campaigns, patient education, provider expertise, company stories and brand initiatives to life across social.


This is not a role for someone who only schedules posts from a content calendar. We’re looking for someone who can **spot a strong idea, shape the story, create the content, publish it and learn from the results.**


Because Serenity operates in healthcare, this role also requires good judgment. The best candidate will know how to create engaging content while handling sensitive topics with care and maintaining the right level of professionalism and compliance.

**Content Creation**

**Campaign Support**  

Partner with the broader marketing team to extend campaigns across social, including clinic launches, awareness initiatives, recruitment campaigns, events and other marketing programs.

**Employee \& Leadership Content**  

Work with clinicians, executives and team members to develop thought leadership and social content that highlights the people behind Serenity.

**Analytics \& Optimization**  

Track performance across channels and use data to understand what is working. Report on reach, engagement, audience growth, traffic and other meaningful metrics, then use those insights to improve future content.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**MARKETING COORDINATOR**

***Full\-Time, Exempt***

**Reports to:** Director of Marketing


**Location:** Remote


Due to compensation and employment law requirements associated with this position, we are not currently accepting applications from candidates residing in California, Washington, New York, Alaska, or Colorado.


We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support the day\-to\-today execution of marketing initiatives across all club locations.


This role is offered by JEM Wellness Brands, the proud franchise operator of Crunch Fitness, the “No Judgment Gym” known for fun, effective workouts. Crunch ranks \#1 in fitness and \#32 overall on Entrepreneur’s Franchise 500 (2025\), with 3M members, 500\+ locations, and its new Crunch 3\.0 gym design.


JEM is growing fast and committed to your future. Since 2022, we are currently at 16 clubs in 4 states (Virginia, Wisconsin, Illinois and California) and set a goal to open 75 new gyms by 2032\.


**Position Overview**


The Marketing Coordinator supports the execution of marketing initiatives that drive membership growth, brand awareness, and member engagement across Limitless Fitness Group's portfolio of Crunch Fitness locations. This role provides critical coordination and administrative support for marketing campaigns, local store marketing efforts, social media initiatives, events, partnerships, creative projects, and club\-level marketing activations.


Working closely with the marketing team, club leadership, agency partners, and vendors, the Marketing Coordinator helps ensure projects are organized, deadlines are met, and marketing programs are executed effectively across multiple markets. This position is ideal for an early\-career marketing professional who is highly organized, detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and excited to gain hands\-on experience in digital marketing, local marketing, campaign management, reporting, community engagement, and new club openings within a fast\-paced, multi\-location business environment.

**Marketing Coordinator Responsibilities**

**Marketing Coordination and Execution**

* Support the execution of companywide, regional, and club\-level marketing campaigns.
* Maintain the marketing calendar, project trackers, promotional schedules, and key deadlines.
* Coordinate marketing requests from club and field leadership, ensuring requests contain the necessary information and follow established processes.
* Assist with preparing campaign briefs, promotional materials, internal communications, and presentations.
* Proofread marketing materials for accuracy, brand consistency, pricing, offer details, and required disclosures.
* Track projects from request through delivery and communicate status updates to relevant stakeholders.

**Creative and Promotional Support**

* Coordinate the creation and distribution of digital and print marketing assets.
* Manage revisions, approvals, and final delivery of flyers, signage, social graphics, emails, direct mail pieces, and other marketing materials.
* Organize and maintain the company’s marketing asset library.
* Help ensure clubs are using current, approved, and brand\-compliant materials.
* Coordinate print production, promotional orders, shipping, and vendor timelines.

**Local Marketing and Club Support**

* Support clubs with local marketing initiatives, community events, grassroots outreach, and in\-club promotions.
* Assist with maintaining local marketing plans and calendars for each club.
* Track participation in community events, corporate partnerships, and local outreach activities.
* Help collect event details, photos, results, and follow\-up information from club teams.
* Maintain lists of community organizations, businesses, events, and potential partnership opportunities.
* Support the administration and fulfillment of corporate wellness and perks partnerships.

**Social Media and Reputation Support**

* Assist with organizing organic social media content, club submissions, and campaign calendars.
* Coordinate with clubs to collect photos, videos, testimonials, and event content.
* Help monitor social media pages, online listings, and review platforms for accuracy and brand consistency.
* Support the development of social captions, promotional messaging, and community\-focused content.
* Identify opportunities to highlight club events, member stories, team members, and community partnerships.

**New Club and Special Project Support**

* Provide administrative and execution support for new club opening campaigns, founding member events, and grand openings.
* Assist with event logistics, promotional materials, lead communication, vendor coordination, and field support.
* Support special marketing projects, leadership meetings, and company presentations as assigned.
* Help document processes and maintain marketing playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures.

**Qualifications**


* Approximately 1\-3 years of marketing, communications, project coordination, or related experience required.
* Strong organizational skills and close attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, presentations, project\-management systems, and shared calendars.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Ability to communicate professionally with executives, agency partners, vendors, and club leadership.
* Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and take ownership of assignments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting marketing campaigns, events, promotions, or community engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with social media platforms, content scheduling tools, and digital marketing best practices.
* Experience using Canva or similar creative design tools.
* Working knowledge of email marketing platforms, CRM systems, project management software, or marketing analytics tools

jobs.description:

***Full\-Time Exempt***

**Reports to:** Director of Marketing


**Location:** Remote


Candidates located in Northern California, the Milwaukee metropolitan area, or the Chicago metropolitan area are strongly preferred. However, exceptional candidates in other locations may be considered based on experience and qualifications.


We’re looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager to drive sustainable membership and revenue growth across all club locations.


This role is offered by JEM Wellness Brands, the proud franchise operator of Crunch Fitness, the “No Judgment Gym” known for fun, effective workouts. Crunch ranks \#1 in fitness and \#32 overall on Entrepreneur’s Franchise 500 (2025\), with 3M members, 500\+ locations, and its new Crunch 3\.0 gym design.


JEM is growing fast and committed to your future. Since 2022, we are currently at 16 clubs in 4 states (Virginia, Wisconsin, Illinois and California) and set a goal to open 75 new gyms by 2032\.


**Position Overview**


The **Growth Marketing Manager** is responsible for driving sustainable membership growth, lead generation, and revenue performance across Limitless Fitness Group's portfolio of open and operating Crunch Fitness locations. This role develops and executes data\-driven marketing strategies that support new member acquisition, improve conversion rates, increase member engagement, and drive same\-store sales growth.


Working closely with the Director of Marketing, operations leadership, club teams, agency partners, and vendors, the Growth Marketing Manager identifies growth opportunities, translates business objectives and club performance data into actionable marketing plans, and ensures effective execution of both digital and local marketing initiatives. This highly collaborative role requires a results\-oriented marketer who can successfully balance strategic planning, performance analysis, campaign management, community partnerships, and field\-level activation to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Growth Marketing Manager Responsibilities**

**Growth Strategy and Performance Ownership**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies that drive membership growth, revenue, leads, joins, and same\-store sales across open and operating clubs.
* Translate company goals and club budgets into actionable market\- and club\-level growth plans.
* Evaluate performance by location, market, offer, channel, audience, and campaign to identify risks and opportunities.
* Build targeted turnaround plans for underperforming clubs and growth plans for clubs with additional market potential.
* Partner with the Director of Marketing to develop annual, quarterly, and monthly growth plans.
* Maintain a strong understanding of each club’s goals, membership trends, competitive environment, and operational needs.

**Campaign Planning and Optimization**

* Lead the execution of promotional campaigns for open and operating locations.
* Develop campaign briefs, market priorities, messaging recommendations, and club\-level activation plans.
* Ensure digital campaigns are supported by strong local marketing, in\-club execution, sales follow\-up, and community visibility.
* Review campaign results and translate findings into clear recommendations for marketing and operations leadership.
* Identify opportunities to test new channels, audiences, offers, creative concepts, and conversion strategies.

**Local and Field Marketing**

* Develop scalable local marketing programs that clubs can execute consistently within their communities.
* Partner with district managers and general managers to create club\-specific plans tied to membership and revenue goals.
* Establish expectations, playbooks, and accountability systems for local outreach, events, grassroots marketing, and community engagement.
* Provide clubs with the resources, tools, messaging, and training needed to execute approved marketing initiatives.
* Regularly assess local execution and identify barriers affecting results.
* Support priority clubs through market visits, community research, competitive analysis, and hands\-on activation when appropriate.

**Corporate Partnerships and Community Growth**

* Identify high\-value organizations and partnership opportunities within each club’s trade area.
* Partner with Corporate Sales Manager to establish a clear process for clubs to generate, qualify, escalate, and manage partnership leads.
* Create partnership packages, presentations, outreach tools, and activation plans.
* Develop programs that can be replicated across multiple clubs and markets.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the primary marketing partner for operations leadership overseeing open and operating clubs.
* Build strong relationships with district managers, general managers, sales teams, and club leadership.
* Lead regular performance discussions and provide clear, actionable marketing recommendations.
* Collaborate with the Senior New Club Marketing Manager to ensure newly opened clubs transition smoothly into the open and operating marketing structure.
* Partner with the Marketing Coordinator to execute campaigns, develop materials, maintain calendars, and track local initiatives.
* Communicate marketing priorities, expectations, results, and next steps clearly across departments.

**Budget and Vendor Management**

* Manage assigned open and operating marketing budgets in partnership with the Director of Marketing.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of local media, sponsorships, partnerships, events, and other marketing expenditures.
* Coordinate with agencies and vendors to ensure work is delivered accurately, on time, and within budget.

**Reporting and Insights**

* Track metrics such as leads, joins, cost per lead, cost per join, conversion rate, membership growth, same\-store sales, and return on marketing investment.
* Identify patterns across markets and translate data into practical actions for the field.

jobs.description:
### **About Us**


Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what's going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We're a technology\-led service with a human touch.### **About the Role**


Scorpion is looking for a proactive, client\-focused Account Manager to support a growing segment of legal clients generated through our partnership with Clio. This is a unique opportunity to help build a new client engagement function from the ground up. You'll work directly with Scorpion hosting clients who use Clio as their primary case\-management platform, helping them activate and get value from the Scorpion–Clio integration, increasing engagement, and identifying opportunities to expand their relationship with Scorpion over time.  

  

Because this is a developing function, you won't simply step into an established playbook. You'll help create it. From developing outreach strategies and call scripts to testing new approaches and identifying what drives client engagement, you'll have the opportunity to influence how Scorpion supports and grows this client segment.  

  

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys working with clients, is comfortable with proactive outreach, has an interest in sales and growth, and is energized by building new processes and finding better ways to engage customers.

* **Identify Growth Opportunities** Use client conversations and available integration data to identify needs and potential opportunities for clients to expand their relationship with Scorpion.
* **Use Data to Inform Outreach** Review available integration and client data to understand engagement, identify trends or opportunities, and prioritize client outreach.
* **Build the Playbook** Help develop and continuously improve call scripts, email messaging, outreach cadences, engagement strategies, and workflows for this growing client segment.
* **Test and Learn** Experiment with different approaches to client engagement, evaluate what works, and use those insights to improve the team's strategy and processes.
* **Collaborate Across Teams** Partner with internal teams supporting the Clio partnership, client experience, sales, and other areas of Scorpion to help create a seamless client experience.
* **Support the Clio Partnership** As the role develops, there may be opportunities to participate in partnership discussions and quarterly business reviews with Clio and contribute insights about client engagement, adoption, and growth opportunities.

### **Who you are and what you bring**


* Education
	+ Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

	+ 2\+ years of experience in a client\-facing role such as customer success, sales, business development, account coordination, or a related function.

	+ Strong problem\-solving skills with a willingness to test new approaches and refine strategies based on results.

	+ Strong organizational skills and follow\-through when managing outreach across a large client population.
	+ Adaptability and comfort working in an evolving environment where processes and priorities may change.
	+ Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and with external partners.
	+ Eagerness to learn new platforms, tools, and technologies.

jobs.title: Enterprise National Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


**The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.**



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation’s largest privately\-held medical waste company serving 35,000\+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we’re actively building — and leading.


**What we do:** We operate as the single compliance partner for non\-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice’s behalf.


**Why it matters:** Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We’re changing that — and we’re looking for people who want to help build what comes next.


**Our technology:** We’re actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add.


**Our impact:** Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready.


**Position Overview:**



The Enterprise National Account Manager owns the full\-cycle sales relationship with mid\-market and enterprise healthcare accounts, converting fragmented, incumbent\-vendor compliance arrangements into a single, coordinated MedPro/MP1 partnership. This role exists to grow MedPro's regulated waste and compliance services footprint across multi\-site healthcare organizations by combining disciplined inbound execution with proactive, self\-sourced outbound pipeline\-building. Success looks like a rep who runs a structured, discovery\-driven sales process, consistently converts a defined inbound/plus\-one mix into closed, recurring\-revenue agreements, and reaches full individual quota (\~$35K/month GP) within 90 days — directly fueling MP1 Solutions' growth as the category\-defining Compliance Services Organization.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Own a full\-cycle enterprise sales pipeline: prospect, qualify, propose, negotiate, and close multi\-site regulated waste and compliance service agreements (RMW, shredding, pharmaceutical/Rx disposal, OSHA/HIPAA/BBP training) with mid\-market and enterprise healthcare accounts (ASCs, FQHCs, multi\-location practice groups, health systems).
* Carry and consistently deliver against an individual quota with a defined mix target across core inbound\-sourced opportunities and self\-sourced (“plus\-one”) pipeline.
* Run a self\-sourced outbound motion in addition to inbound lead work — closed\-lost account win\-back calling, partner referral channels, or account\-based outbound calling segmented by vertical.
* Execute a structured, discovery\-driven sales process: identify the caller’s core pain (new office setup vs. dissatisfaction with an incumbent vendor), confirm the decision\-maker/gatekeeper, position MedPro’s Low Cost Guarantee and bundled service offering, and drive every call to a clear next step or a direct ask for the business.
* Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and pipeline accuracy in Salesforce, including accurate stage, forecast, and next\-step data.
* Meet weekly activity, pipeline\-creation, and script\-adherence standards tied to MedPro’s lead\-access scorecard.
* Manage populated service addenda and proposal documentation for multi\-site accounts, coordinating with internal teams (compliance, account setup, billing) through contract execution and onboarding handoff.
* Participate in ongoing sales enablement — script and objection\-handling refinement, AI\-assisted call coaching (Steel Trap) feedback, and collateral/process improvement input.


**Required Qualifications:**


* Years of experience: 3\+ years of full\-cycle B2B sales experience carrying and consistently exceeding an individual quota, ideally in a solution\-selling or multi\-product/service environment rather than a single\-SKU or single\-product background
* Industry background: Proven ability to manage a complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycle — identifying decision\-makers and gatekeepers, navigating multi\-site/multi\-location accounts, and closing recurring\-revenue service agreements (not just one\-time transactions); strong outbound/self\-sourcing discipline in addition to working inbound leads
* Technical skills: CRM proficiency (Salesforce preferred) and comfort operating inside a metrics\-driven, scorecard\-based performance environment; excellent discovery and consultative selling skills — able to run a structured discovery conversation rather than a feature/price pitch
* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred (business, healthcare administration, or related field) but not required in lieu of relevant experience


**Nice\-to\-Have:**


* Demonstrated experience selling into healthcare, medical, dental, or other regulated/compliance\-driven verticals (or a clearly transferable regulated\-services sales background); experience selling against an entrenched incumbent competitor (competitive displacement sales)
* Familiarity with value\-based, guarantee\-backed, or price\-lock sales models; prior experience with AI\-assisted call coaching/QA tools


**Compensation and Benefits:**


* Earning Potential: OTE of $115K–$135K\+ with uncapped commissions
* Career Growth: Clear advancement pathways, mentorship, and ongoing training

The Role

Mabbly is a Chicago Go\-To\-Market Agency, and we are hiring an Account Manager to join our accounts team. You would work alongside our Strategy, Brand, Digital and Product Studios, all of them in the same building as you.

Let's be clear about what this is. We are looking for someone with roughly 2 to 3 years of agency or client\-facing experience who is sharp, malleable and hungry to grow. You would not be the last line of defense on an account. You would have a senior leader above you whose actual job is to make you better at this. Account Director is the destination, not the starting line.

If you have been waiting for a role where someone invests in your trajectory instead of handing you a static job description, this is it.

A word about who we are right now. Mabbly has been an agency for over a decade, but in the past year we rebuilt ourselves to operate like a startup. We run our entire business on Claude, Claude Cowork and Notion. We build our own internal AI agents. We automate anything that should not require a human. You will learn account management the way it is going to be practiced for the next decade, not the way it was practiced for the last one.

Honest note before you apply: this is an intense role inside a company in the middle of its biggest transformation ever. Priorities shift, the pace is real, and the people who thrive here find that energizing rather than exhausting. If you want a quiet seat and a settled playbook, this is not your job. If you want to help write the playbook and grow faster than any big agency would let you, keep reading.

What You Will Do Client partnership and communication

* Own daily client relationships. Build credibility by understanding each client's business, not just their deliverables.
* Run client meetings, calls and status updates with polish, and grow into leading presentations to senior stakeholders.
* Anticipate client questions before they arrive and bring solutions, looping in experts across our studios when needed.
* Prepare clean agendas, recaps, proposals and follow\-ups that keep projects moving.
* Chase what is stuck. A real part of this job is the polite, persistent follow\-up that stops a project sitting for three weeks waiting on one approval. We will teach you the cadence. You have to be willing to run it.

Execution and project ownership

* Manage planning and execution across campaigns, web builds, brand work and content.
* Keep client and internal teams aligned through every stage of the project lifecycle.
* Learn your clients' processes, including the ones that constrain us: approval chains, regulatory review, IT release windows. Knowing that a code change has to be submitted Wednesday to ship Friday is the difference between hitting a date and missing it.
* Work in the weeds. Everyone here does, including the founder.

Quality control

* Be the set of eyes before a client sees anything. Copy, links, formatting, brand consistency, and whether the work actually answers the brief.
* Build and maintain the checklist for your accounts, so quality does not depend on one person remembering.
* Send work back when it is not ready. This is harder than it sounds, and it is a large part of why clients renew.

Scope, budget and systems

* Translate signed work orders into real plans: deliverables and dates in Asana, hours in Harvest.
* Track contracted hours against hours used, and flag movement in both directions. Under\-delivery loses renewals. Over\-delivery loses margin.
* Keep a clear record of what was scoped, what was delivered and what remains, so anyone can answer the question without archaeology.

AI\-powered account operations

* Use Claude, Claude Cowork and Notion daily for meeting prep, recaps, reporting, research and client communication. We will train you. Curiosity is the prerequisite, not prior mastery.
* Help improve our internal AI agents and workflows. Spot something repetitive? We automate it, and you will be part of that.

Growth

* Learn to spot upsell opportunities inside your accounts and bring them forward.
* Take on increasing portfolio ownership as you prove it, on a defined path toward Account Director.
* Communicate account performance and wins to leadership regularly.

What Success Looks Like

We will not tell you to be "measurably more capable every quarter" and leave you to guess what that means. Here is what we actually watch, weekly.

* **Contracted deliverables due this week go out this week.**
* **Contracted hours land between 90 and 105 percent of what the client is entitled to.** Both ends of that band are failures, for different reasons.
* **Fewer than 20 percent of your client tasks are overdue** at any given moment.
* **Every account you touch has a conversation with someone senior on the client side at least every 30 days.**
* **Nothing reaches a client that you have not checked.**
* **Clients renew, and they use your name when they explain why.**

These numbers are on a scorecard the whole delivery team reads every week. You will always know where you stand, which is more than most agencies can say.

Within 18 to 24 months the goal is that you are operating at Account Director level, because we built you there on purpose.

What We Need In You

* **Experience.** 2 to 3 years in client management, account coordination or project management, ideally in an agency or marketing environment. Digital marketing familiarity strongly preferred.
* **Communication.** Excellent written and verbal skills, with the instinct to translate technical ideas for non\-technical audiences.
* **Attention to detail.** You are the person who catches the thing everyone else read past. If you have ever found the typo on the live site, tell us about it.
* **Coachability.** You seek feedback, absorb it fast and apply it. This matters more to us than your resume.
* **Organization.** Comfortable holding several accounts and many moving pieces without dropping any of them.

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, Gateway - GEM
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The **Regional Account Manager, Gateway (RAM)** is a key field position and will have the opportunity to run their own business within their assigned region. Reporting to the Area Business Director, West, this individual will possess experience in business ownership, leadership, analytics, and the implementation of innovative solutions. The RAM will formulate an effective regional strategy focusing on Geneticist, Endocrinology, and Metabolic Specialist as their core customers. They will be tasked with establishing short\- and long\-term business tactics. It will be the responsibility of the RAM to identify key priorities within territories and create and implement business plan that is organizationally approved and fully compliant with all laws. The RAM will be accountable for improving diagnosis rates of all on label indications within their region, growing sales, and effectively partnering across the organization to ensure all goals are met.



The successful RAM will have courage, talent and dedication to seek solutions that can make a meaningful impact within territory or broader team. The ideal candidates are detail orientated, self\-structured in their approach to their work, with the ability to manage relationships at all levels. The RAM will have proven presentation and partner management skills and thrive in a rapid paced and dynamic environment within a culture that relies on a patient centric and teamwork orientated approach.



\*\*\*Gateway territory includes IL, WI, MN, IA, and Eastern MO. Preferred candidate location is the Chicagoland area; however, the right candidate will be considered.\*\*


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Understands and effectively communicates complex scientific information
* Develops and implements strategic region\-level business plans
* Collaborates cross\-functionally with internal stakeholders (e.g., Marketing, Market Access, Medical, Operations, Compliance)
* Drives innovative, accountable, and entrepreneurial approaches to business challenges
* Demonstrates strong organizational and time management skills
* Exhibits a strong commitment to customer experience and standards of excellence
* Applies strong business acumen to inform decision\-making
* Demonstrates high integrity and adherence to compliance standards
* Demonstrates adaptability and effectiveness in fast\-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environments


**QUALIFICATIONS**


**Education/Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, including 3 years of field\-based experience in account management, sales, and/or field reimbursement
* Experience in specialty, genetics, or rare disease markets strongly preferred
* Proven success in product launches, ideally with first\-in\-class therapies and in competitive markets
* Experience navigating complex rare disease patient journeys, including diagnosis, referral pathways, and access challenges
* Experience working in ambiguous environments requiring cross\-specialty coordination for patient identification
* Experience managing a large multi\-state geography preferred
* Ability to travel frequently (up to 70% overnight) and maintain a valid driver's license


\#LI\-REMOTE


Mirum Pharmaceuticals is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all Federal, State and Local laws that prohibit employment discrimination on the basis of race, age, national origin, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship, genetic disposition or characteristics, disability, veteran's status or any other classification protected by applicable State/Federal/Local laws.
