jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
The **Key Account Manager** serves as a strategic partner for high\-value, complex customer accounts, driving long\-term retention, growth, and innovation across the portfolio. They develop and execute account strategies that maximize customer value while aligning customer objectives with organizational capabilities. They build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, identify expansion opportunities, and lead cross\-functional teams to deliver exceptional business outcomes. As the primary customer advocate, they proactively manage risk, resolve complex challenges, and champion continuous improvement initiatives.


Success in this role requires deep expertise in supply chain, logistics, transportation, and distribution solutions, combined with strong commercial acumen and executive presence. Experience supporting customers in life sciences, aerospace, automotive, high\-tech, industrial manufacturing, or other complex industries is highly valued.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans that drive customer retention and revenue growth.
* Build and maintain executive\-level relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and primary strategic contact.
* Lead business reviews, executive alignment meetings, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and maintain strategic alignment.
* Partner with customers to develop growth roadmaps, innovation strategies, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify, qualify, and pursue expansion opportunities across services, business units, geographies, and solution offerings.
* Own customer performance metrics and KPIs, delivering insights and recommendations that improve operational and financial results.
* Lead resolution of complex business challenges while balancing customer needs with organizational objectives.
* Collaborate with Operations, Sales, Finance, Solutions Design, IT, Engineering, and Implementation teams to ensure successful customer outcomes.
* Translate customer goals, challenges, and priorities into actionable internal strategies and resource plans.
* Champion digital transformation, automation, and technology\-enabled solutions that increase customer value and operational efficiency.
* Monitor account health, identify retention risks, and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
* Drive account forecasting, revenue planning, and strategic growth initiatives.
* Represent the organization in executive sponsor programs, customer strategy sessions, industry events, and other high\-visibility engagements.
* Provide market intelligence, industry insights, and competitive feedback to support business planning and solution development.
* Promote a customer\-centric culture by influencing and aligning cross\-functional stakeholders around account objectives and customer commitments.
* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

 **Qualifications**

* Education: Undergraduate degree in a related field from an accredited college or university required.
* Certification/Licensure: Professional certifications such as CSCMP, APICS/ASCM, or similar credentials preferred.
* Experience: 8\+ years of progressive experience in strategic account management, enterprise customer success, business development, or related customer\-facing leadership roles.
* Proven success managing complex customer portfolios with annual revenues of approximately $15M to $50M\+ while consistently achieving retention and growth objectives.
* Deep expertise in logistics, transportation, supply chain management, contract logistics, warehousing, distribution, or related industries.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing account growth strategies that drive revenue expansion, customer retention, and profitability.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence, negotiate, and build credibility with senior leaders internally and externally.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and driving alignment across Sales, Operations, Finance, IT, Solutions Design, Engineering, and Implementation functions.
* Experience supporting customers in complex industries such as life sciences, aerospace, automotive, high\-tech, industrial manufacturing, consumer goods, or related sectors preferred.
* Exceptional analytical, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills with a consultative approach to problem solving.
* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
* Environment: Remote; must be comfortable with travel for related meetings/events.

**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

 **The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

 **Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills

 **Desired Requirements:**

* Respiratory Experience

  

The annual base salary for this position is **$60,000 – $90,000**. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and/or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager- icometrix (icobrain)
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own the post\-sale health of an assigned portfolio of icobrain customers. You'll drive optimized clinical use of the tool, deliver strong year\-over\-year renewals, and grow utilization inside every account you touch. While the preferred candidate will carry their own book of strategic accounts they may also be asked to assist in shaping the playbooks and standards the customer success function runs on.  

  

icobrain, from icometrix — a GE HealthCare company — is FDA\-cleared AI software that turns routine brain MRI into quantitative results clinicians act on across MS, dementia and Alzheimer's, ARIA monitoring, epilepsy, and TBI.**Job Description**
===================

**About the role**


icometrix, a GE HealthCare company, builds icobrain — FDA\-cleared, CE\-marked AI software that turns routine brain MRI into quantitative, clinically actionable measurements across multiple sclerosis, dementia and Alzheimer's disease, ARIA monitoring, epilepsy, stroke, and traumatic brain injury.


We are looking for a Customer Success Leader to own the post\-sale health of an assigned portfolio of icobrain accounts. The preferred candidate will personally manage a book of strategic customers and may be asked to assist in setting the standards, playbooks, and quality processes the broader customer success function runs on, and mentoring peers as the team scales.


Your mandate is straightforward — customers who use icobrain well, renew. You are accountable for driving optimized, sustained clinical utilization of icobrain across your accounts, and for translating that utilization into high year\-over\-year renewal rates and expanding clinical adoption within each institution.

**What you'll do**

*Own account health and renewals*

* Serve as the primary post\-sale relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of icobrain customers, from radiology and neurology leadership to IT, PACS administrators, and MR technologists.
* Build and execute account\-level success plans with defined utilization targets, clinical adoption milestones, and renewal timelines.
* Monitor utilization data continuously, identify accounts trending toward under\-use or risk, and drive corrective action well ahead of renewal.
* Deliver year\-over\-year renewal performance and grow clinical utilization — more indications, more referring clinicians, more scans analyzed — within existing accounts.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort presenting to physician and executive audiences.
* Ability to work effectively across a large, matrixed organization to get things done.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

*Strongly preferred*

* Direct neuroimaging experience — brain MRI acquisition, protocol optimization, or quantitative neuroimaging analysis.
* Clinical or technical credentials such as RT(R)(MR), radiologic technologist, MR physicist, or a neuroscience/neurology background.
* Working familiarity with MS, dementia and Alzheimer's disease, ARIA monitoring in the context of amyloid\-targeting therapy, epilepsy, or TBI imaging workflows.

* Experience introducing AI or quantitative imaging software into clinical practice, including change management wi

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
SpaDerma is Chicago’s leading medical spa, providing Cosmetic Injectables, Laser Hair Removal, and Advanced Skincare with more than 20 years of experience. Our team of nearly 150 employees across five locations includes highly skilled Aestheticians and Injectors who provide effective treatments using some of the most advanced technology available.  

  

Our spas are known for their warm, approachable atmosphere and knowledgeable providers who make patients feel comfortable, informed, and confident in their treatment plans. SpaDerma’s brand reflects that same experience: creative, youthful, innovative, educational, and never intimidating.  

  

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Social Media Manager to lead SpaDerma’s social media strategy, content development, community growth, provider social media program, influencer and ambassador initiatives, and social performance reporting.  

  

This individual will oversee SpaDerma’s primary social channels while also helping drive performance across the broader network of SpaDerma\-associated accounts, including the individual professional accounts of 80\+ Aestheticians and Injectors. The role requires a combination of strategic leadership and hands\-on execution.  

  

Responsibilities  

  

Social Media Strategy \& Management  

  

* Develop and execute SpaDerma’s social media strategy in alignment with overall marketing and business objectives.
* Manage SpaDerma’s social presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging platforms, including content calendars and publishing.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice, visual identity, and messaging across all SpaDerma\-associated social accounts.


  

Content Creation \& Community Management  

  

* Lead the creation of engaging photo, video, educational, promotional, and trend\-driven content.
* Plan and execute recurring content shoots across SpaDerma locations, events, partnerships, trainings, and activations.
* Manage community engagement and identify high\-quality user and provider\-generated content for amplification.
* Develop social campaigns and giveaways that support engagement, audience growth, brand awareness, and partnerships.


  

Provider Social Media Program  

  

* Lead SpaDerma’s social media program for 80\+ Aestheticians and Injectors with individual professional SpaDerma accounts.
* Develop ongoing training, coaching, resources, and content opportunities to increase provider participation and performance.
* Partner with providers to translate their expertise and personalities into engaging, brand\-aligned social content.
* Establish goals and evaluate provider participation, account growth, engagement, and content performance.


  

Analytics \& Performance  

  

* Establish, track, and report on KPIs including audience growth, reach, engagement, traffic, conversions, lead generation, and ROI.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of social campaigns, influencer and ambassador programs, giveaways, and other initiatives.
* Use performance insights to continuously optimize content, platform strategy, posting cadence, and campaigns.
* Present key results and recommendations to leadership and connect social performance to website traffic, bookings, and broader marketing outcomes.


  

Influencer \& Ambassador Programs  

  

* Develop and manage SpaDerma’s influencer and ambassador strategies, including recruitment, relationships, campaigns, deliverables, and performance.
* Coordinate influencer visits, treatments, content requirements, and partnership deliverables.
* Review program KPIs to assess effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.


  

PR, Events \& Partnerships  

  

* Serve as a key liaison with SpaDerma’s PR agency to coordinate social opportunities, influencer initiatives, media moments, and brand activations.
* Partner with the marketing team on events, partnerships, sponsorships, and community initiatives, developing social strategies that maximize awareness and engagement.
* Attend and capture content at approximately 2\+ events per month, including occasional evening and weekend events.


  

Team Leadership \& Collaboration  

  

* Manage and provide direction to designated marketing team members supporting social media and content initiatives.
* Establish priorities, delegate projects, provide feedback, and support team development.
* Partner closely with the Marketing Director and collaborate across marketing, operations, providers, leadership, agencies, and vendors.
* Develop scalable processes and guidelines to support the continued growth of SpaDerma’s social media program.


  

Paid Advertising  

  

* Support or manage paid advertising across Meta and Google, including campaign strategy, creative coordination, optimization, and reporting.
* Analyze campaign performance and recommend opportunities to improve conversions, efficiency, and return on ad spend.


  

Additional Responsibilities  

  

* Support additional marketing initiatives and special projects as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


  

Requirements  

  

* Demonstrated success managing and growing professional brand social media accounts.
* Experience measuring campaign performance, KPIs, conversions, and ROI.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly self\-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of projects from strategy through execution.
* Available to work some evenings and weekends.


  

Education \& Experience  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media, or a related field preferred.
* 4\+ years of professional social media, digital marketing, or related experience preferred.
* Minimum 2\+ years of people management experience.
* Experience managing influencer, creator, or ambassador programs preferred.
* Experience working with PR agencies, creative agencies, or external marketing partners pre
